title.zh: 卷三百五十八 列傳第一百十七 李綱上
title.raw: 卷三百五十八 列傳第一百十七 李綱上 Volume 358 Biographies 117: Li Gang 1

sentences.zh: 李綱 上

translations.literal: Li Gang, Part One
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang (Part One)

sentences.zh: 李綱，字伯紀，邵武人也，自其祖始居無錫。

translations.literal: Li Gang, styled Boji, was a man of Shaowu; from his grandfather's generation onward his family dwelt in Wuxi.
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang, styled Boji, was a native of Shaowu; his family had lived in Wuxi since his grandfather's time.

sentences.zh: 父夔，終龍圖閣待制。

translations.literal: His father was Kui, who ended his career as Attendant-Draftsman of the Dragon Diagram Hall.
translations.idiomatic: His father Kui served to the end as Attendant-Draftsman of the Dragon Diagram Hall.

sentences.zh: 綱登政和二年進士第，積官至監察御史兼權殿中侍御史，以言事忤權貴，改比部員外郎，遷起居郎。

translations.literal: Gang passed the jinshi examination in the second year of Zhenghe; by successive promotions he reached the posts of Investigating Censor and Acting Palace Attendant Censor; because his memorials on public affairs offended powerful men, he was transferred to be Secretary of the Ministry of Revenue and then moved to Attendant on the Emperor's Movements.
translations.idiomatic: Gang passed the jinshi examination in the second year of the Zhenghe reign (1112). He rose to Investigating Censor with concurrent appointment as Acting Palace Attendant Censor. When his memorials on state affairs offended the powerful, he was reassigned as Secretary of the Ministry of Revenue and later promoted to Attendant on the Emperor's Movements.

sentences.zh: 宣和元年，京師大水，綱上疏言陰氣太盛，當以盜賊外患為憂。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuanhe, the capital suffered great flooding; Gang submitted a memorial saying that yin energy was excessive and that bandits and foreign threats ought to be the source of concern.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuanhe (1119), when the capital was struck by severe floods, Gang submitted a memorial arguing that yin forces had grown too strong and that the court should worry about banditry and foreign invasion.

sentences.zh: 朝廷惡其言，謫監南劍州沙縣稅務。

translations.literal: The court resented his words and demoted him to supervise the tax office at Shaxian in Nanjian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The court took offense at his words and demoted him to supervise the tax office at Shaxian in Nanjian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七年，為太常少卿。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he became Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Xuanhe, he was appointed Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 時金人渝盟，邊報狎至，朝廷議避敵之計，詔起師勤王，命皇太子為開封牧，令侍從各具所見以聞。

translations.literal: At that time the Jurchens had broken the treaty; frontier reports arrived in quick succession; the court debated plans to avoid the enemy; an edict ordered armies raised to rescue the throne; the crown prince was made Governor of Kaifeng; and the emperor's attendants were commanded each to submit his views.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Jurchens had violated the alliance. Frontier reports poured in one after another. As the court debated how to evade the enemy, an edict ordered troops raised to rescue the throne, appointed the crown prince Governor of Kaifeng, and directed the emperor's attendants each to submit his views.

sentences.zh: 綱上御戎五策，且語所善給事中吳敏曰：「建牧之議，豈非欲委以留守之任乎？

translations.literal: Gang submitted Five Strategies for Defense Against the Barbarians, and said to his friend Supervising Secretary Wu Min: "The proposal to establish a governor—does it not mean to entrust him with the duty of holding the capital?"
translations.idiomatic: Gang submitted his Five Strategies for Defense Against the Barbarians and said to his friend Supervising Secretary Wu Min, "The proposal to establish a governor—is it not meant to entrust someone with holding the capital?"

sentences.zh: 巨敵猖獗如此，非傳以位號，不足以招徠天下豪傑。

translations.literal: With so great an enemy raging so wildly, unless a title and rank are transmitted to him, it will not suffice to summon the heroes of the realm.
translations.idiomatic: With so mighty an enemy raging so wildly, unless he is given a title and rank, it will not suffice to summon the heroes of the realm.

sentences.zh: 東宮恭儉之德聞於天下，以守宗社可也。

translations.literal: The crown prince's respectful and frugal virtue is known throughout the realm; he can be entrusted to guard the altars of state.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's respectful and frugal virtue is known throughout the realm; he is fit to guard the altars of state.

sentences.zh: 公以獻納論思為職，曷不為上極言之。

translations.literal: You, sir, have the duty of presenting and remonstrating and deliberating with the ruler—why not speak to the utmost to the emperor on this?
translations.idiomatic: You, sir, have the duty of presenting memorials, remonstrating, and deliberating with the ruler—why not speak to the emperor as forcefully as you can on this?

sentences.zh: 」敏曰：「監國可乎？

translations.literal: Min said: "Would regency suffice?"
translations.idiomatic: Min said, "Would regency suffice?"

sentences.zh: 」綱曰：「肅宗靈武之事，不建號不足以復邦，而建號之議不出於明皇，後世惜之。

translations.literal: Gang said: "In the affair of Emperor Suzong at Lingwu, without establishing a reign title it was not enough to restore the state; yet the proposal to establish a reign title did not come from Emperor Ming of Tang, and later ages have regretted it."
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "In Emperor Suzong's affair at Lingwu, without establishing a reign title it was not enough to restore the state; yet the proposal to establish a reign title did not come from Emperor Ming of Tang, and later ages have regretted that."

sentences.zh: 主上聰明仁恕，公言萬一能行，將見金人悔禍，宗社底寧，天下受其賜。

translations.literal: Our lord is intelligent, benevolent, and forgiving; if your words should by any chance be carried out, we shall see the Jurchens repent their calamity, the altars of state settled in peace, and the realm receive the benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Our lord is intelligent, benevolent, and forgiving. If your words should by any chance be carried out, we shall see the Jurchens repent their violence, the altars of state restored to peace, and the realm receive the benefit.

sentences.zh: 」翌日，敏請對，具道所以，因言李綱之論，蓋與臣同。

translations.literal: The next day Min requested an audience and fully explained his reasons, adding that Li Gang's view was essentially the same as his own.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Min requested an audience, fully explained his reasons, and added that Li Gang's view was essentially the same as his own.

sentences.zh: 有旨召綱入議，綱刺臂血上疏云：「皇太子監國，典禮之常也。

translations.literal: An edict summoned Gang to join the deliberations; Gang pricked his arm and wrote a memorial in blood, saying: "For the crown prince to regent is a matter of ordinary ritual."
translations.idiomatic: An edict summoned Gang to join the deliberations. He pricked his arm and wrote a memorial in blood, saying, "For the crown prince to regent is a matter of ordinary ritual."

sentences.zh: 今大敵入攻，安危存亡在呼吸間，猶守常禮可乎？

translations.literal: Now a great enemy has entered in attack; safety and survival hang in the breath between life and death—can one still cling to ordinary ritual?"
translations.idiomatic: Now a great enemy has entered in attack; safety and survival hang by a thread—can one still cling to ordinary ritual?"

sentences.zh: 名分不正而當大權，何以號召天下，期成功于萬一哉？

translations.literal: If one's title and status are not correct yet one holds great power, how can one summon the realm and hope for success even in the slightest degree?"
translations.idiomatic: If one's title and status are not correct yet one holds great power, how can one summon the realm and hope for success even in the slightest degree?"

sentences.zh: 若假皇太子以位號，使為陛下守宗社，收將士心，以死捍敵，天下可保。

translations.literal: If the crown prince is temporarily given a title and rank, made to guard the altars of state for Your Majesty, and wins the hearts of generals and soldiers so that they die defending against the enemy, the realm can be preserved."
translations.idiomatic: If the crown prince is temporarily given a title and rank, made to guard the altars of state for Your Majesty, and wins the hearts of generals and soldiers so that they die defending against the enemy, the realm can be preserved."

sentences.zh: 」疏上，內禪之議乃決。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, the plan for abdication was decided.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was submitted, the plan for abdication was decided.

sentences.zh: 欽宗即位，綱上封事，謂：「方今中國勢弱，君子道消，法度紀綱，蕩然無統。

translations.literal: When Emperor Qinzong took the throne, Gang submitted a sealed memorial, saying: "At present China's strength is weak, the way of the superior man is in decline, and laws, standards, and discipline are utterly without order."
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Qinzong took the throne, Gang submitted a sealed memorial, saying, "At present China's strength is weak, the way of the superior man is in decline, and laws, standards, and discipline are utterly without order."

sentences.zh: 陛下履位之初，當上應天心，下順人欲。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Your Majesty's accession, you ought above to respond to Heaven's heart and below to accord with the people's desires.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Your Majesty's accession, you ought above to respond to Heaven's heart and below to accord with the people's desires.

sentences.zh: 攘除外患，使中國之勢尊；

translations.literal: Drive out foreign calamities and make China's position honored;
translations.idiomatic: Drive out foreign calamities and make China's position honored;

sentences.zh: 誅鋤內奸，使君子之道長，以副道君皇帝付託之意。

translations.literal: execute and root out inner traitors and make the way of the superior man grow long, to fulfill the intent with which the Retired Emperor entrusted you."
translations.idiomatic: execute and root out inner traitors and make the way of the superior man grow long, to fulfill the intent with which the Retired Emperor entrusted you."

sentences.zh: 」召對延和殿，上迎謂綱曰：「朕頃在東宮，見卿論水災疏，今尚能誦之。

translations.literal: He was summoned for audience in the Yanshe Hall; the emperor came forward to meet him and said to Gang: "When I was lately in the Eastern Palace, I saw your memorial on the flood disaster, and I can still recite it."
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned for audience in the Yanshe Hall. The emperor came forward to meet him and said to Gang, "When I was lately in the Eastern Palace, I saw your memorial on the flood disaster, and I can still recite it."

sentences.zh: 」李鄴使金議割地，綱奏：「祖宗疆土，當以死守，不可以尺寸與人。

translations.literal: Li Ye was sent to the Jurchens to negotiate ceding territory; Gang memorialized: "The territory of our ancestors must be defended to the death; not an inch may be given to others."
translations.idiomatic: Li Ye was sent to the Jurchens to negotiate ceding territory. Gang memorialized, "The territory of our ancestors must be defended to the death; not an inch may be given to others."

sentences.zh: 」欽宗嘉納，除兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: Emperor Qinzong approved and accepted this, and appointed him Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Qinzong approved and accepted this, and appointed him Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年，以吳敏為行營副使，綱為參謀官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingkang, Wu Min was made Deputy Commissioner of the Mobile Headquarters and Gang was made Staff Officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingkang (1126), Wu Min was made Deputy Commissioner of the Mobile Headquarters and Gang was made Staff Officer.

sentences.zh: 金將斡離不兵渡河，徽宗東幸，宰執議請上暫避敵鋒。

translations.literal: The Jurchen general Wanyan Zongwang crossed the Yellow River with his army; Emperor Huizong traveled east; and the chief ministers debated asking the emperor temporarily to avoid the enemy's edge.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchen general Wanyan Zongwang crossed the Yellow River with his army. Emperor Huizong traveled east, and the chief ministers debated asking the emperor temporarily to avoid the enemy's edge.

sentences.zh: 綱曰：「道君皇帝挈宗社以授陛下，委而去之可乎？

translations.literal: Gang said: "The Retired Emperor entrusted the altars of state to Your Majesty—can you cast them aside and leave?"
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "The Retired Emperor entrusted the altars of state to Your Majesty—can you cast them aside and leave?"

sentences.zh: 」上默然。

translations.literal: The emperor was silent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was silent.

sentences.zh: 太宰白時中謂都城不可守，綱曰：「天下城池，豈有如都城者，且宗廟社稷、百官萬民所在，舍此欲何之？

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor Bai Shizhong said the capital could not be held; Gang said: "Of all the walled cities under Heaven, is there any like the capital? Moreover, the ancestral temples, altars of soil and grain, officials, and myriad people are all here—abandoning this, where would you go?"
translations.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Bai Shizhong said the capital could not be held. Gang said, "Of all the walled cities under Heaven, is there any like the capital? Moreover, the ancestral temples, altars of soil and grain, officials, and myriad people are all here—abandoning this, where would you go?"

sentences.zh: 」上顧宰執曰：「策將安出？

translations.literal: The emperor turned to the chief ministers and said: "What plan shall we adopt?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor turned to the chief ministers and said, "What plan shall we adopt?"

sentences.zh: 」綱進曰：「今日之計，當整飭軍馬，固結民心，相與堅守，以待勤王之師。

translations.literal: Gang stepped forward and said: "Today's plan should be to put the army and horses in order, solidify the people's hearts, hold fast together, and await the armies coming to rescue the throne."
translations.idiomatic: Gang stepped forward and said, "Today's plan should be to put the army and horses in order, solidify the people's hearts, hold fast together, and await the armies coming to rescue the throne."

sentences.zh: 」上問誰可將者，綱曰：「朝廷以高爵厚祿崇養大臣，蓋將用之於有事之日。

translations.literal: The emperor asked who could command the troops; Gang said: "The court honors great ministers with high rank and rich stipends precisely so that they may be used on the day of need."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked who could command the troops. Gang said, "The court honors great ministers with high rank and rich stipends precisely so that they may be used on the day of need."

sentences.zh: 白時中、李邦彥等雖未必知兵，然籍其位號，撫將士以抗敵鋒，乃其職也。

translations.literal: Although Bai Shizhong, Li Bangyan, and the rest may not necessarily understand warfare, by virtue of their rank and titles they ought to reassure the generals and soldiers and resist the enemy's edge—that is their duty.
translations.idiomatic: Although Bai Shizhong, Li Bangyan, and the rest may not necessarily understand warfare, by virtue of their rank and titles they ought to reassure the generals and soldiers and resist the enemy's edge—that is their duty.

sentences.zh: 」時中忿曰：「李綱莫能將兵出戰否？

translations.literal: Shizhong said angrily: "Can Li Gang not take troops out to fight?"
translations.idiomatic: Shizhong said angrily, "Can Li Gang not take troops out to fight?"

sentences.zh: 」綱曰：「陛下不以臣庸懦，儻使治兵，願以死報。

translations.literal: Gang said: "If Your Majesty does not consider me mediocre and weak, and should you put me in charge of the army, I wish to repay you with my death."
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "If Your Majesty does not consider me mediocre and weak, and should you put me in charge of the army, I wish to repay you with my death."

sentences.zh: 」乃以綱為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: Thereupon Gang was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Gang was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 宰執猶守避敵之議。

translations.literal: The chief ministers still clung to the plan of avoiding the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers still clung to the plan of avoiding the enemy.

sentences.zh: 有旨以綱為東京留守，綱為上力陳所以不可去之意，且言：「明皇聞潼關失守，即時幸蜀，宗廟朝廷毀於賊手，范祖禹以為其失在於不能堅守以待援。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Gang Commissioner for the Eastern Capital; Gang forcefully explained to the emperor why he must not leave, and said: "When Emperor Ming of Tang heard that Tong Pass had fallen, he at once traveled to Shu; the ancestral temples and court were destroyed at the hands of bandits; Fan Zuyu held that his error lay in not being able to hold fast and await relief."
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Gang Commissioner for the Eastern Capital. Gang forcefully explained to the emperor why he must not leave, and said, "When Emperor Ming of Tang heard that Tong Pass had fallen, he at once traveled to Shu; the ancestral temples and court were destroyed at the hands of bandits. Fan Zuyu held that his error lay in not being able to hold fast and await relief."

sentences.zh: 今四方之兵不日雲集，陛下奈何輕舉以蹈明皇之覆轍乎？

translations.literal: Now armies from the four quarters will gather like clouds within days—how can Your Majesty lightly move and tread the overturned cart of Emperor Ming?"
translations.idiomatic: Now armies from the four quarters will gather like clouds within days—how can Your Majesty lightly move and tread the overturned cart of Emperor Ming?"

sentences.zh: 」上意頗悟。

translations.literal: The emperor's mind was somewhat enlightened.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's mind was somewhat enlightened.

sentences.zh: 會內侍奏中宮已行，上色變，倉卒降禦榻曰：「朕不能留矣。

translations.literal: Just then a eunuch reported that the empress had already departed; the emperor's expression changed, and in haste he descended from the imperial couch and said: "I cannot remain."
translations.idiomatic: Just then a eunuch reported that the empress had already departed. The emperor's expression changed, and in haste he descended from the imperial couch and said, "I cannot remain."

sentences.zh: 」綱泣拜，以死邀之。

translations.literal: Gang wept and bowed, blocking his way with the threat of death.
translations.idiomatic: Gang wept and bowed, blocking his way with the threat of death.

sentences.zh: 上顧綱曰：「朕今為卿留。

translations.literal: The emperor looked at Gang and said: "I shall now remain for your sake."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor looked at Gang and said, "I shall now remain for your sake."

sentences.zh: 治兵禦敵之事，專責之卿，勿令有疏虞。

translations.literal: Matters of organizing troops and resisting the enemy I entrust entirely to you—see that there is no negligence."
translations.idiomatic: Matters of organizing troops and resisting the enemy I entrust entirely to you—see that there is no negligence."

sentences.zh: 」綱皇恐受命。

translations.literal: Gang received the commission in fear and trembling.
translations.idiomatic: Gang received the commission in fear and trembling.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復決意南狩，綱趨朝，則禁衛擐甲，乘輿已駕矣。

translations.literal: Before long the emperor again resolved on a southern tour; Gang hurried to court, but the palace guards were already armored and the imperial carriage had already been harnessed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the emperor again resolved on a southern tour. Gang hurried to court, but the palace guards were already armored and the imperial carriage had already been harnessed.

sentences.zh: 綱急呼禁衛曰：「爾等願守宗社乎，願從幸乎？

translations.literal: Gang urgently called to the palace guards: "Do you wish to guard the altars of state, or do you wish to follow the imperial tour?"
translations.idiomatic: Gang urgently called to the palace guards, "Do you wish to guard the altars of state, or do you wish to follow the imperial tour?"

sentences.zh: 」皆曰：「願死守。

translations.literal: All said: "We wish to die holding fast."
translations.idiomatic: All said, "We wish to die holding fast."

sentences.zh: 」綱入見曰：「陛下已許臣留，復戒行何也？

translations.literal: Gang entered and said in audience: "Your Majesty already promised that I might remain—why again warn of departure?"
translations.idiomatic: Gang entered and said in audience, "Your Majesty already promised that I might remain—why again warn of departure?"

sentences.zh: 今六軍父母妻子皆在都城，願以死守，萬一中道散歸，陛下孰與為衛？

translations.literal: Now the parents, wives, and children of the Six Armies are all in the capital; they wish to die holding it fast. If midway they scatter and return, with whom will Your Majesty be guarded?"
translations.idiomatic: Now the parents, wives, and children of the Six Armies are all in the capital; they wish to die holding it fast. If midway they scatter and return, with whom will Your Majesty be guarded?"

sentences.zh: 敵兵已逼，知乘輿未遠，以健馬疾追，何以禦之？

translations.literal: The enemy's troops have already pressed close; knowing that the imperial carriage is not far off, with swift horses they will pursue hotly—how can they be resisted?"
translations.idiomatic: The enemy's troops have already pressed close. Knowing that the imperial carriage is not far off, with swift horses they will pursue hotly—how can they be resisted?"

sentences.zh: 」上感悟，遂命輟行。

translations.literal: The emperor was moved to understanding and ordered the journey halted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was moved to understanding and ordered the journey halted.

sentences.zh: 綱傳旨語左右曰：「敢復有言去者斬！

translations.literal: Gang transmitted an edict to those around him, saying: "Whoever again speaks of leaving shall be beheaded!"
translations.idiomatic: Gang transmitted an edict to those around him, saying, "Whoever again speaks of leaving shall be beheaded!"

sentences.zh: 」禁衛皆拜伏呼萬歲，六軍聞之，無不感泣流涕。

translations.literal: The palace guards all bowed prostrate and shouted "Ten thousand years!" When the Six Armies heard this, none failed to be moved to tears.
translations.idiomatic: The palace guards all bowed prostrate and shouted "Ten thousand years!" When the Six Armies heard this, none failed to be moved to tears.

sentences.zh: 命綱為親征行營使，以便宜從事。

translations.literal: Gang was appointed Commissioner of the Mobile Headquarters for the Emperor's Personal Campaign, with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: Gang was appointed Commissioner of the Mobile Headquarters for the Emperor's Personal Campaign, with discretionary authority.

sentences.zh: 綱治守戰之具，不數日而畢。

translations.literal: Gang prepared the equipment for defense and battle, and within a few days all was complete.
translations.idiomatic: Gang prepared the equipment for defense and battle, and within a few days all was complete.

sentences.zh: 敵兵攻城，綱身督戰，募壯士縋城而下，斬酋長十余人，殺其眾數千人。

translations.literal: When the enemy attacked the city, Gang personally supervised the fighting; he recruited brave men to be lowered by rope down the wall, and more than ten chieftains were beheaded and several thousand of the enemy were killed.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy attacked the city, Gang personally supervised the fighting. He recruited brave men to be lowered by rope down the wall; more than ten chieftains were beheaded and several thousand of the enemy were killed.

sentences.zh: 金人知有備，又聞上已內禪，乃退。

translations.literal: The Jurchens knew there was preparation, and hearing also that the emperor had already abdicated within the palace, they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens knew there was preparation, and hearing also that the emperor had already abdicated within the palace, they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 求遣大臣至軍中議和，綱請行。

translations.literal: They requested that a great minister be sent to the army to negotiate peace; Gang asked to go.
translations.idiomatic: They requested that a great minister be sent to the army to negotiate peace; Gang asked to go.

sentences.zh: 上遣李棁，綱曰：「安危在此一舉，臣恐李棁怯懦而誤國事也。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Li Zhuo; Gang said: "Safety and peril hang on this one move—I fear Li Zhuo is cowardly and will ruin the affairs of state."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Li Zhuo. Gang said, "Safety and peril hang on this one move—I fear Li Zhuo is cowardly and will ruin the affairs of state."

sentences.zh: 」上不聽，竟使棁往。

translations.literal: The emperor would not listen and ultimately sent Zhuo.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor would not listen and ultimately sent Zhuo.

sentences.zh: 金人須金幣以千萬計，求割太原、中山、河間地，以親王、宰相為質。

translations.literal: The Jurchens demanded gold and coin by the tens of millions, sought the cession of Taiyuan, Zhongshan, and Hejian, and demanded a prince of the blood and a chief minister as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens demanded gold and coin by the tens of millions, sought the cession of Taiyuan, Zhongshan, and Hejian, and demanded a prince of the blood and a chief minister as hostages.

sentences.zh: 棁受事，自不措一辭，還報。

translations.literal: Zhuo received his commission and did not venture a single word in reply; he returned to report.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuo received his commission and did not venture a single word in reply; he returned to report.

sentences.zh: 綱謂：「所需金幣，竭天下且不足，況都城乎？

translations.literal: Gang said: "The gold and coin required would exhaust the realm and still not suffice—how much less the capital?"
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "The gold and coin required would exhaust the realm and still not suffice—how much less the capital?"

sentences.zh: 三鎮，國之遮罩，割之何以立國？

translations.literal: The three garrisons are the realm's shield—if they are ceded, how can a state be established?"
translations.idiomatic: The three garrisons are the realm's shield—if they are ceded, how can a state be established?"

sentences.zh: 至於遣質，即宰相當往，親王不當往。

translations.literal: As for sending hostages, the chief minister ought to go; a prince of the blood ought not to go.
translations.idiomatic: As for sending hostages, the chief minister ought to go; a prince of the blood ought not to go.

sentences.zh: 若遣辯士姑與之議所以可不可者，宿留數日，大兵四集，彼孤軍深入，雖不得所欲，亦將速歸。

translations.literal: If eloquent envoys are sent to discuss provisionally what may or may not be done and are detained for several days, when great armies gather from the four quarters the enemy, a lone army deep in hostile territory, though they may not obtain what they desire, will also return quickly.
translations.idiomatic: If eloquent envoys are sent to discuss provisionally what may or may not be done and are detained for several days, when great armies gather from the four quarters the enemy, a lone army deep in hostile territory, though they may not obtain what they desire, will also return quickly.

sentences.zh: 此時而與之盟，則不敢輕中國，而和可久也。

translations.literal: At that time, if a treaty is made with them, they will not dare lightly despise China, and peace can be lasting.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, if a treaty is made with them, they will not dare lightly despise China, and peace can be lasting.

sentences.zh: 」宰執議不合，綱不能奪，求去。

translations.literal: The chief ministers' deliberations did not agree; Gang could not prevail and asked to leave.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers' deliberations did not agree; Gang could not prevail and asked to leave.

sentences.zh: 上慰諭曰：「卿第出治兵，此事當徐議之。

translations.literal: The emperor comforted and instructed him, saying: "You need only go out and organize the army; this matter can be discussed slowly."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor comforted and instructed him, saying, "You need only go out and organize the army; this matter can be discussed slowly."

sentences.zh: 」綱退，則誓書已行，所求皆與之，以皇弟康王、少宰張邦昌為質。

translations.literal: When Gang withdrew, the oath document had already been issued and everything requested was granted; the emperor's younger brother, Prince Kang, and Junior Grand Councilor Zhang Bangchang were sent as hostages.
translations.idiomatic: When Gang withdrew, the oath document had already been issued and everything requested was granted. The emperor's younger brother, Prince Kang, and Junior Grand Councilor Zhang Bangchang were sent as hostages.

sentences.zh: 時朝廷日輸金幣，而金人需求不已，日肆暑掠。

translations.literal: At that time the court daily sent gold and coin, yet the Jurchens' demands did not cease, and each day they wantonly plundered and burned.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the court daily sent gold and coin, yet the Jurchens' demands did not cease, and each day they wantonly plundered and burned.

sentences.zh: 四方勤王之師漸有至者，種師道、姚平仲亦以涇原、秦鳳兵至。

translations.literal: Armies coming from the four quarters to rescue the throne gradually began to arrive; Zhong Shidao and Yao Pingzhong also arrived with troops from Jingyuan and Qinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Armies coming from the four quarters to rescue the throne gradually began to arrive; Zhong Shidao and Yao Pingzhong also arrived with troops from Jingyuan and Qinfeng.

sentences.zh: 綱奏言：「金人貪婪無厭，凶悖已甚，其勢非用師不可。

translations.literal: Gang memorialized, saying: "The Jurchens are insatiably greedy and have become extremely violent and rebellious; their situation is such that troops must be used."
translations.idiomatic: Gang memorialized, saying, "The Jurchens are insatiably greedy and have become extremely violent and rebellious; their situation is such that troops must be used."

sentences.zh: 且敵兵號六萬，而吾勤王之師集城下者已二十余萬；

translations.literal: Moreover, the enemy troops are said to number sixty thousand, while the armies coming to rescue the throne gathered below the walls already exceed two hundred thousand;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the enemy troops are said to number sixty thousand, while the armies coming to rescue the throne gathered below the walls already exceed two hundred thousand;

sentences.zh: 彼以孤軍入重地，猶虎豹自投檻阱中，當以計取之，不必與角一旦之力。

translations.literal: They have entered deep territory with a lone army, like tigers and leopards throwing themselves into cages and traps—they should be taken by stratagem; there is no need to contend with them for a single day's strength.
translations.idiomatic: They have entered deep territory with a lone army, like tigers and leopards throwing themselves into cages and traps—they should be taken by stratagem; there is no need to contend with them for a single day's strength.

sentences.zh: 若扼河津，絕餉道，分兵復畿北諸邑，而以重兵臨敵營，堅壁勿戰，如周亞夫所以困七國者。

translations.literal: If the river crossings are held fast, supply routes cut off, troops divided to recover the districts north of the capital, and heavy forces positioned facing the enemy camp with walls held firm and no battle fought, as Zhou Yafu used to wear down the Seven Kingdoms,
translations.idiomatic: If the river crossings are held fast, supply routes cut off, troops divided to recover the districts north of the capital, and heavy forces positioned facing the enemy camp with walls held firm and no battle fought, as Zhou Yafu used to wear down the Seven Kingdoms,

sentences.zh: 俟其食盡力疲，然後以一檄取誓書，復三鎮，縱其北歸，半渡而擊之；

translations.literal: wait until their food is exhausted and their strength spent, then with a single dispatch recover the oath document and the three garrisons, let them return north, and strike them halfway across;
translations.idiomatic: wait until their food is exhausted and their strength spent, then with a single dispatch recover the oath document and the three garrisons, let them return north, and strike them halfway across;

sentences.zh: 此必勝之計也。

translations.literal: this is a plan certain to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: this is a plan certain to succeed.

sentences.zh: 」上深以為然，約日舉事。

translations.literal: The emperor deeply approved and set a date for action.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deeply approved and set a date for action.

sentences.zh: 姚平仲勇而寡謀，急於要功，先期率步騎萬人，夜斫敵營，欲生擒幹離不及取康王以歸。

translations.literal: Yao Pingzhong was brave but lacked counsel, eager for achievement; ahead of schedule he led ten thousand infantry and cavalry by night to strike the enemy camp, intending to capture Wanyan Zongwang alive and take Prince Kang back.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Pingzhong was brave but lacked counsel, eager for achievement. Ahead of schedule he led ten thousand infantry and cavalry by night to strike the enemy camp, intending to capture Wanyan Zongwang alive and take Prince Kang back.

sentences.zh: 夜半，中使傳旨論綱曰：「姚平仲已舉事，卿速援之。

translations.literal: At midnight an emissary from the palace transmitted an edict telling Gang: "Yao Pingzhong has already acted—you must quickly go to his aid."
translations.idiomatic: At midnight an emissary from the palace transmitted an edict telling Gang, "Yao Pingzhong has already acted—you must quickly go to his aid."

sentences.zh: 」綱率諸將旦出封丘門，與金人戰幕天坡，以神臂弓射金人，卻之。

translations.literal: Gang led the generals out at dawn through the Fengqiu Gate and fought the Jurchens at Mutianpo; with the divine arm crossbow he shot at the Jurchens and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: Gang led the generals out at dawn through the Fengqiu Gate and fought the Jurchens at Mutianpo. With the divine arm crossbow he shot at the Jurchens and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 平仲竟以襲敵營不克，懼誅亡去。

translations.literal: Pingzhong, because his raid on the enemy camp failed, feared execution and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Pingzhong, because his raid on the enemy camp failed, feared execution and fled.

sentences.zh: 金使來，宰相李邦彥語之曰：「用兵乃李綱、姚平仲，非朝廷意。

translations.literal: When the Jurchen envoy came, Chief Councilor Li Bangyan told him: "The use of troops was Li Gang's and Yao Pingzhong's doing—not the court's intent."
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchen envoy came, Chief Councilor Li Bangyan told him, "The use of troops was Li Gang's and Yao Pingzhong's doing—not the court's intent."

sentences.zh: 」遂罷綱，以蔡懋代之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Gang was dismissed and Cai Mao replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Gang was dismissed and Cai Mao replaced him.

sentences.zh: 太學生陳東等詣闕上書，明綱無罪。

translations.literal: Imperial University students Chen Dong and others went to the palace gate and submitted a memorial, clarifying that Gang was innocent.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial University students Chen Dong and others went to the palace gate and submitted a memorial, clarifying that Gang was innocent.

sentences.zh: 軍民不期而集者數十萬，呼聲動地，恚不得報，至殺傷內侍。

translations.literal: Soldiers and civilians, without having arranged it beforehand, gathered by the hundreds of thousands; their shouts shook the earth; indignant that they received no reply, they even killed and wounded eunuchs.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers and civilians, without having arranged it beforehand, gathered by the hundreds of thousands. Their shouts shook the earth. Indignant that they received no reply, they even killed and wounded eunuchs.

sentences.zh: 帝亟召綱，綱入見，泣拜請死。

translations.literal: The emperor urgently summoned Gang; Gang entered in audience, wept, bowed, and asked for death.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor urgently summoned Gang. Gang entered in audience, wept, bowed, and asked for death.

sentences.zh: 帝亦泣，命綱復為尚書右丞，充京城四壁守禦使。

translations.literal: The emperor also wept and ordered Gang restored as Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Commissioner for the Defense of the Four Walls of the Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also wept and ordered Gang restored as Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Commissioner for the Defense of the Four Walls of the Capital.

sentences.zh: 始，金人犯城者，蔡懋禁不得輒施矢石，將士積憤，至是，綱下令能殺敵者厚賞，眾無不奮躍。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Jurchens attacked the city, Cai Mao had forbidden the use of arrows and stones without authorization; the officers and soldiers had accumulated resentment. Now Gang issued orders that whoever could kill the enemy would receive rich rewards, and none failed to leap forward eagerly.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Jurchens attacked the city, Cai Mao had forbidden the use of arrows and stones without authorization; the officers and soldiers had accumulated resentment. Now Gang issued orders that whoever could kill the enemy would receive rich rewards, and none failed to leap forward eagerly.

sentences.zh: 金人懼，稍稍引卻，且得割三鎮詔及親王為質，乃退師。

translations.literal: The Jurchens were afraid and gradually withdrew; having also obtained the edict ceding the three garrisons and a prince as hostage, they then withdrew their army.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens were afraid and gradually withdrew. Having also obtained the edict ceding the three garrisons and a prince as hostage, they then withdrew their army.

sentences.zh: 除綱知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Gang was appointed Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Gang was appointed Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 綱奏請如澶淵故事，遣兵護送，且戒諸將，可擊則擊之。

translations.literal: Gang memorialized requesting that, following the precedent of Chanyuan, troops be sent to escort them, and that the generals be warned that when they could strike, they should strike.
translations.idiomatic: Gang memorialized requesting that, following the precedent of Chanyuan, troops be sent to escort them, and that the generals be warned that when they could strike, they should strike.

sentences.zh: 乃以兵十萬分道並進，將士受命，踴躍以行。

translations.literal: Thereupon one hundred thousand troops advanced in separate columns; officers and soldiers received their orders and marched eagerly.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon one hundred thousand troops advanced in separate columns; officers and soldiers received their orders and marched eagerly.

sentences.zh: 先是，金帥粘罕圍太原，守將折可求、劉光世軍皆敗；

translations.literal: Earlier, the Jurchen commander Wanyan Nianhan had besieged Taiyuan; the defending generals Zhe Keqiu and Liu Guangshi were both defeated;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the Jurchen commander Wanyan Nianhan had besieged Taiyuan; the defending generals Zhe Keqiu and Liu Guangshi were both defeated;

sentences.zh: 平陽府義兵亦叛，導金人入南北關，取隆德府，至是，遂攻高平。

translations.literal: The righteous militia of Pingyang Prefecture also rebelled, guiding the Jurchens through the North and South Passes and taking Longde Prefecture; by this time they attacked Gaoping.
translations.idiomatic: The righteous militia of Pingyang Prefecture also rebelled, guiding the Jurchens through the North and South Passes and taking Longde Prefecture; by this time they attacked Gaoping.

sentences.zh: 宰相咎綱盡遣城下兵追敵，恐倉卒無措，急征諸將還。

translations.literal: The chief ministers blamed Gang for having sent all the troops below the walls in pursuit of the enemy, fearing that in haste nothing could be done, and urgently recalled the generals.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers blamed Gang for having sent all the troops below the walls in pursuit of the enemy, fearing that in haste nothing could be done, and urgently recalled the generals.

sentences.zh: 諸將已追及金人于刑、趙間，遽得還師之命，無不扼腕。

translations.literal: The generals had already pursued the Jurchens between Xing and Zhao when they suddenly received orders to return; none failed to wring their hands in frustration.
translations.idiomatic: The generals had already pursued the Jurchens between Xing and Zhao when they suddenly received orders to return; none failed to wring their hands in frustration.

sentences.zh: 比綱力爭，復追，而將士解體矣。

translations.literal: By the time Gang argued forcefully and pursuit was resumed, the officers and soldiers had lost their fighting spirit.
translations.idiomatic: By the time Gang argued forcefully and pursuit was resumed, the officers and soldiers had lost their fighting spirit.

sentences.zh: 詔議迎太上皇帝還京。

translations.literal: An edict ordered deliberation on welcoming the Retired Emperor back to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered deliberation on welcoming the Retired Emperor back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 初，徽宗南幸，童貫、高俅等以兵扈從。

translations.literal: At first, when Emperor Huizong traveled south, Tong Guan, Gao Qiu, and others escorted him with troops.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Emperor Huizong traveled south, Tong Guan, Gao Qiu, and others escorted him with troops.

sentences.zh: 既行，聞都城受圍，乃止東南郵傳及勤王之師。

translations.literal: After they had departed, hearing that the capital was besieged, they halted the southeastern relay posts and the armies coming to rescue the throne.
translations.idiomatic: After they had departed, hearing that the capital was besieged, they halted the southeastern relay posts and the armies coming to rescue the throne.

sentences.zh: 道路籍籍，言貫等為變。

translations.literal: Along the roads there was widespread talk that Tong and the others were plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Along the roads there was widespread talk that Tong and the others were plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 陳東上書，乞誅蔡京、蔡攸、童貫、朱勔、高俅、盧宗原等。

translations.literal: Chen Dong submitted a memorial requesting execution of Cai Jing, Cai You, Tong Guan, Zhu Mian, Gao Qiu, Lu Zongyuan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Dong submitted a memorial requesting execution of Cai Jing, Cai You, Tong Guan, Zhu Mian, Gao Qiu, Lu Zongyuan, and others.

sentences.zh: 議遣聶山為發運使往圖之，綱曰：「使山所圖果成，震驚太上，此憂在陛下。

translations.literal: It was proposed to send Nie Shan as Transport Commissioner to deal with them; Gang said: "If Shan's plan should succeed, the shock to the Retired Emperor would be a worry for Your Majesty."
translations.idiomatic: It was proposed to send Nie Shan as Transport Commissioner to deal with them. Gang said, "If Shan's plan should succeed, the shock to the Retired Emperor would be a worry for Your Majesty."

sentences.zh: 萬一不果，是數人者，挾太上于東南，求劍南一道，陛下將何以處之？

translations.literal: If by any chance it should fail, those several men, taking the Retired Emperor to the southeast and seeking a circuit in Jiannan—how would Your Majesty deal with that?"
translations.idiomatic: If by any chance it should fail, those several men, taking the Retired Emperor to the southeast and seeking a circuit in Jiannan—how would Your Majesty deal with that?"

sentences.zh: 莫若罷山之行，請於太上去此數人，自可不勞而定。

translations.literal: Better to cancel Shan's mission and request that the Retired Emperor remove those several men—then things can be settled without labor."
translations.idiomatic: Better to cancel Shan's mission and request that the Retired Emperor remove those several men—then things can be settled without labor."

sentences.zh: 」上從其言。

translations.literal: The emperor followed his advice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed his advice.

sentences.zh: 徽宗還次南都，以書問改革政事之故，且召吳敏、李綱。

translations.literal: When Emperor Huizong returned and stopped at Nandu, he sent a letter asking the reason for reforming government affairs, and also summoned Wu Min and Li Gang.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Huizong returned and stopped at Nandu, he sent a letter asking the reason for reforming government affairs, and also summoned Wu Min and Li Gang.

sentences.zh: 或慮太上意有不測，綱請行，曰：「此無他，不過欲知朝廷事爾。

translations.literal: Some feared the Retired Emperor's intent might be unpredictable; Gang asked to go, saying: "This is nothing else—it is only that he wishes to know the affairs of the court."
translations.idiomatic: Some feared the Retired Emperor's intent might be unpredictable. Gang asked to go, saying, "This is nothing else—it is only that he wishes to know the affairs of the court."

sentences.zh: 」綱至，具道皇帝聖孝思慕，欲以天下養之意，請陛下早還京師。

translations.literal: When Gang arrived, he fully explained the emperor's filial piety and longing, his wish to support the Retired Emperor with the realm, and requested that His Majesty return early to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When Gang arrived, he fully explained the emperor's filial piety and longing, his wish to support the Retired Emperor with the realm, and requested that His Majesty return early to the capital.

sentences.zh: 徽宗泣數行下，問：「卿頃以何故去？

translations.literal: Emperor Huizong wept for several lines and asked: "For what reason did you leave before?"
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Huizong wept for several lines and asked, "For what reason did you leave before?"

sentences.zh: 」綱對曰：「臣昨任左史，以狂妄論列水災，蒙恩寬斧鉞之誅，然臣當時所言，以謂天地之變，各以類應，正為今日攻圍之兆。

translations.literal: Gang replied: "Your servant formerly served as Left Historian; because of reckless discussion in memorials on the flood disaster, I received the grace of being spared the punishment of the axe; yet what I said at that time was that the changes of Heaven and earth each respond according to their kind—it was precisely a portent of today's siege."
translations.idiomatic: Gang replied, "Your servant formerly served as Left Historian. Because of reckless discussion in memorials on the flood disaster, I received the grace of being spared the punishment of the axe; yet what I said at that time was that the changes of Heaven and earth each respond according to their kind—it was precisely a portent of today's siege."

sentences.zh: 夫災異變故，譬猶一人之身，病在五臟，則發於氣色，形於脈息，善醫者能知之。

translations.literal: Calamities and strange events are like a person's body: when disease is in the five viscera, it appears in the complexion and in the pulse; a skilled physician can know it.
translations.idiomatic: Calamities and strange events are like a person's body: when disease is in the five viscera, it appears in the complexion and in the pulse; a skilled physician can know it.

sentences.zh: 所以聖人觀變于天地，而修其在我者，故能制治保邦，而無危亂之憂。

translations.literal: Therefore the sage observes changes in Heaven and earth and rectifies what lies within himself; thus he can govern and preserve the state without the worry of peril and disorder."
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the sage observes changes in Heaven and earth and rectifies what lies within himself; thus he can govern and preserve the state without the worry of peril and disorder."

sentences.zh: 」徽宗稱善。

translations.literal: Emperor Huizong praised this.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Huizong praised this.

sentences.zh: 又詢近日都城攻圍守禦次第，語漸浹洽。

translations.literal: He also inquired about the recent sequence of siege and defense at the capital, and their words gradually became harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: He also inquired about the recent sequence of siege and defense at the capital, and their words gradually became harmonious.

sentences.zh: 徽宗因及行宮止遞角等事，曰：「當時恐金人知行宮所在，非有他也。

translations.literal: Emperor Huizong then spoke of halting relay posts at the traveling palace and other matters, saying: "At that time I feared the Jurchens would learn where the traveling palace was—it was nothing else."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Huizong then spoke of halting relay posts at the traveling palace and other matters, saying, "At that time I feared the Jurchens would learn where the traveling palace was—it was nothing else."

sentences.zh: 」綱奏：「方艱危時，兩宮隔絕，朝廷應副行宮，亦豈能無不至者，在聖度燭之耳。

translations.literal: Gang memorialized: "In times of extreme peril, when the two palaces were cut off from each other, the court's responses to the traveling palace could not but have some that did not arrive—it is only that the sage's measure illuminates this."
translations.idiomatic: Gang memorialized, "In times of extreme peril, when the two palaces were cut off from each other, the court's responses to the traveling palace could not but have some that did not arrive—it is only that the sage's measure illuminates this."

sentences.zh: 」且言：「皇帝仁孝，惟恐有一不當太上皇帝意者，每得詰問之詔，輒憂懼不食。

translations.literal: He also said: "The emperor is filial and benevolent; he fears only that there may be something not to the Retired Emperor's liking. Whenever he receives an edict of inquiry, he is anxious and will not eat."
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "The emperor is filial and benevolent; he fears only that there may be something not to the Retired Emperor's liking. Whenever he receives an edict of inquiry, he is anxious and will not eat."

sentences.zh: 臣竊譬之，家長出而強寇至，子弟之任家事者，不得不從宜措置。

translations.literal: Your servant ventures to compare it to this: when the head of a household goes out and fierce bandits arrive, the younger members charged with household affairs cannot but take appropriate measures as the occasion requires.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant ventures to compare it to this: when the head of a household goes out and fierce bandits arrive, the younger members charged with household affairs cannot but take appropriate measures as the occasion requires.

sentences.zh: 長者但當以其能保田園大計而慰勞之，苟誅及細故，則為子弟者，何所逃其責哉？

translations.literal: The elder ought only to comfort them for having preserved the great plan of fields and gardens; if petty matters are punished, how can the younger members escape blame?"
translations.idiomatic: The elder ought only to comfort them for having preserved the great plan of fields and gardens; if petty matters are punished, how can the younger members escape blame?"

sentences.zh: 皇帝傳位之初，陛下巡幸，適當大敵入攻，為宗社計，庶事不得不小有更革。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the emperor's transfer of the throne, when Your Majesty traveled on tour, it happened that a great enemy entered in attack; for the sake of the altars of state, many things could not but be slightly changed.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the emperor's transfer of the throne, when Your Majesty traveled on tour, it happened that a great enemy entered in attack; for the sake of the altars of state, many things could not but be slightly changed.

sentences.zh: 陛上回鑾，臣謂宜有以大慰安皇帝之心，勿問細故可也。

translations.literal: When Your Majesty returns in the imperial carriage, your servant holds that there ought to be something greatly to comfort and reassure the emperor's heart—do not inquire into petty matters."
translations.idiomatic: When Your Majesty returns in the imperial carriage, your servant holds that there ought to be something greatly to comfort and reassure the emperor's heart—do not inquire into petty matters."

sentences.zh: 」徽宗感悟，出玉帶、金魚、象簡賜綱，曰：「行宮人得卿來皆喜，以此示朕意，卿可便服之。

translations.literal: Emperor Huizong was moved to understanding and bestowed on Gang an jade belt, golden fish, and ivory tally, saying: "The people at the traveling palace are all delighted that you have come; take these to show my intent—you may wear them at once."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Huizong was moved to understanding and bestowed on Gang a jade belt, golden fish, and ivory tally, saying, "The people at the traveling palace are all delighted that you have come; take these to show my intent—you may wear them at once."

sentences.zh: 」且曰：「卿輔助皇帝、捍守宗社有大功，若能調和父子間，使無疑阻，當遂書青史，垂名萬世。

translations.literal: He also said: "You have great merit in assisting the emperor and defending the altars of state; if you can harmonize the relations between father and son so that there is no suspicion or obstruction, you will be recorded in the blue annals and your name will last ten thousand generations."
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "You have great merit in assisting the emperor and defending the altars of state. If you can harmonize the relations between father and son so that there is no suspicion or obstruction, you will be recorded in the blue annals and your name will last ten thousand generations."

sentences.zh: 」綱感泣再拜。

translations.literal: Gang wept in gratitude and bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: Gang wept in gratitude and bowed again.

sentences.zh: 綱還，具道太上意。

translations.literal: When Gang returned, he fully reported the Retired Emperor's intent.
translations.idiomatic: When Gang returned, he fully reported the Retired Emperor's intent.

sentences.zh: 宰執進迎奉太上儀注，耿南仲議欲屏太上左右，車駕乃進。

translations.literal: The chief ministers submitted the protocol for welcoming the Retired Emperor; Geng Nanzhong proposed wishing to remove those around the Retired Emperor before the imperial carriage could advance.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers submitted the protocol for welcoming the Retired Emperor; Geng Nanzhong proposed wishing to remove those around the Retired Emperor before the imperial carriage could advance.

sentences.zh: 綱言：「如此，是示之以疑也。

translations.literal: Gang said: "To do this is to show him suspicion."
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "To do this is to show him suspicion."

sentences.zh: 天下之理，誠與疑、明與暗而已。

translations.literal: The principle of the realm is sincerity and doubt, clarity and obscurity alone.
translations.idiomatic: The principle of the realm is sincerity and doubt, clarity and obscurity alone.

sentences.zh: 自誠明而推之，可至於堯、舜；

translations.literal: From sincerity and clarity one may extend it and reach Yao and Shun;
translations.idiomatic: From sincerity and clarity one may extend it and reach Yao and Shun;

sentences.zh: 自疑暗而推之，其患有不可勝言者。

translations.literal: from doubt and obscurity one may extend it and the calamities are beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: from doubt and obscurity one may extend it and the calamities are beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 耿南仲不以堯、舜之道輔陛下，乃暗而多疑。

translations.literal: Geng Nanzhong does not assist Your Majesty with the way of Yao and Shun, but is obscure and full of doubts."
translations.idiomatic: Geng Nanzhong does not assist Your Majesty with the way of Yao and Shun, but is obscure and full of doubts."

sentences.zh: 」南仲怫然曰：「臣適見左司諫陳公輔，乃為李綱結士民伏闕者，乞下御史置對。

translations.literal: Nanzhong said angrily: "Your servant has just seen Remonstrance Officer Chen Gongfu—it was he who, for Li Gang, rallied scholars and civilians to kneel at the palace gate; I request that he be sent down to the censorate for interrogation."
translations.idiomatic: Nanzhong said angrily, "Your servant has just seen Remonstrance Officer Chen Gongfu—it was he who, for Li Gang, rallied scholars and civilians to kneel at the palace gate; I request that he be sent down to the censorate for interrogation."

sentences.zh: 」上愕然。

translations.literal: The emperor was startled.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was startled.

sentences.zh: 綱曰：「臣與南仲所論，國事也。

translations.literal: Gang said: "What Nanzhong and I were discussing was the affairs of state."
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "What Nanzhong and I were discussing was the affairs of state."

sentences.zh: 南仲乃為此言，臣何敢復有所辨？

translations.literal: Yet Nanzhong speaks thus—how dare I further offer any defense?"
translations.idiomatic: Yet Nanzhong speaks thus—how dare I further offer any defense?"

sentences.zh: 願以公輔事下吏，臣得乞身待罪。

translations.literal: I request that the matter of Gongfu be sent to the officials, and that I may beg to retire and await punishment."
translations.idiomatic: I request that the matter of Gongfu be sent to the officials, and that I may beg to retire and await punishment."

sentences.zh: 」章十餘上，不允。

translations.literal: He submitted more than ten memorials and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted more than ten memorials and was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 太上皇帝還，綱迎拜國門。

translations.literal: When the Retired Emperor returned, Gang welcomed and bowed at the Gate of the Realm.
translations.idiomatic: When the Retired Emperor returned, Gang welcomed and bowed at the Gate of the Realm.

sentences.zh: 翌日，朝龍德宮，退，復上章懇辭。

translations.literal: The next day, after audience at Longde Palace, he withdrew and again submitted a memorial earnestly requesting to resign.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, after audience at Longde Palace, he withdrew and again submitted a memorial earnestly requesting to resign.

sentences.zh: 上手詔諭意曰：「乃者敵在近郊，士庶伏闕，一朝倉猝，眾數十萬，忠憤所激，不謀同辭，此豈人力也哉？

translations.literal: The emperor personally wrote an edict of instruction, saying: "Lately the enemy was near the suburbs; scholars and commoners knelt at the palace gate. In a morning's haste, the multitude numbered hundreds of thousands; loyal indignation stirred them and they spoke as one without prior arrangement—how could this be human effort alone?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally wrote an edict of instruction, saying, "Lately the enemy was near the suburbs; scholars and commoners knelt at the palace gate. In a morning's haste, the multitude numbered hundreds of thousands; loyal indignation stirred them and they spoke as one without prior arrangement—how could this be human effort alone?"

sentences.zh: 不悅者造言，致卿不自安，朕深諒卿，不足介懷。

translations.literal: Those who were displeased spread rumors and made you uneasy; I deeply understand you—do not take it to heart."
translations.idiomatic: Those who were displeased spread rumors and made you uneasy; I deeply understand you—do not take it to heart."

sentences.zh: 巨敵方退，正賴卿協濟艱難，宜勉為朕留。

translations.literal: The great enemy has just withdrawn; I rely on you to assist in these difficult times—you ought to make an effort and remain for my sake."
translations.idiomatic: The great enemy has just withdrawn; I rely on you to assist in these difficult times—you ought to make an effort and remain for my sake."

sentences.zh: 」綱不得已就職。

translations.literal: Gang had no choice but to take up his post.
translations.idiomatic: Gang had no choice but to take up his post.

sentences.zh: 上備邊禦敵八事。

translations.literal: The emperor issued eight items on border defense and resisting the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued eight items on border defense and resisting the enemy.

sentences.zh: 時北兵已去，太上還宮，上下恬然，置邊事於不問。

translations.literal: At that time the northern troops had already departed, the Retired Emperor had returned to the palace, and above and below were at ease, setting border affairs aside without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the northern troops had already departed, the Retired Emperor had returned to the palace, and above and below were at ease, setting border affairs aside without inquiry.

sentences.zh: 綱獨以為憂，與同知樞密院事許翰議調防秋之兵。

translations.literal: Gang alone was worried and, with Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Xu Han, deliberated on mobilizing troops for autumn defense.
translations.idiomatic: Gang alone was worried and, with Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Xu Han, deliberated on mobilizing troops for autumn defense.

sentences.zh: 吳敏乞置詳議司檢詳法制，以革弊政，詔以綱為提舉官，南仲沮止之。

translations.literal: Wu Min requested establishing a Detailed Deliberation Office to examine laws and institutions in order to reform corrupt government; an edict made Gang the supervising official, but Nanzhong obstructed and stopped it.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Min requested establishing a Detailed Deliberation Office to examine laws and institutions in order to reform corrupt government; an edict made Gang the supervising official, but Nanzhong obstructed and stopped it.

sentences.zh: 綱奏：「邊患方棘，調度不給，宜稍抑冒濫，以足國用。

translations.literal: Gang memorialized: "The border peril is acute and allocations are insufficient; one ought slightly to restrain excessive and indiscriminate appointments to fill the state's needs."
translations.idiomatic: Gang memorialized, "The border peril is acute and allocations are insufficient; one ought slightly to restrain excessive and indiscriminate appointments to fill the state's needs."

sentences.zh: 謂如節度使至遙郡刺史，本以待勳臣，今皆以戚裏恩澤得之；

translations.literal: For example, posts from military commissioner down to distant prefectural governor were originally to reward meritorious ministers; now all obtain them through favor to consorts and affines;
translations.idiomatic: For example, posts from military commissioner down to distant prefectural governor were originally to reward meritorious ministers; now all obtain them through favor to consorts and affines;

sentences.zh: 堂吏轉官止于正郎，崇、觀間始轉至中奉大夫，今宜皆復舊制。

translations.literal: Hall clerks' promotions stopped at Regular Gentleman; only in the Chong and Guan periods did they begin to be promoted to Grand Master for Court Audience; now all ought to be restored to the old system."
translations.idiomatic: Hall clerks' promotions stopped at Regular Gentleman; only in the Chong and Guan periods did they begin to be promoted to Grand Master for Court Audience; now all ought to be restored to the old system."

sentences.zh: 」執政揭其奏通衢，以綱得士民心，欲因此離之。

translations.literal: The chief ministers posted his memorial in the public thoroughfare, wishing thereby to separate him because Gang had won the hearts of scholars and the people.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers posted his memorial in the public thoroughfare, wishing thereby to separate him because Gang had won the hearts of scholars and the people.

sentences.zh: 會守禦司奏補副尉二人，御批有「大臣專權，浸不可長」語。

translations.literal: Just then the Defense Office memorialized recommending two men for supplementary deputy commandant posts; the emperor's draft annotation contained the words "great ministers monopolize authority—this must not be allowed to grow."
translations.idiomatic: Just then the Defense Office memorialized recommending two men for supplementary deputy commandant posts; the emperor's draft annotation contained the words "great ministers monopolize authority—this must not be allowed to grow."

sentences.zh: 綱奏：「頃得旨給空名告敕，以便宜行事。

translations.literal: Gang memorialized: "Your servant recently received an edict granting blank appointment documents to act at discretion."
translations.idiomatic: Gang memorialized, "Your servant recently received an edict granting blank appointment documents to act at discretion."

sentences.zh: 二人有勞當補官，故具奏聞，乃遵上旨，非專權也。」

translations.literal: These two men had merit and ought to be given office, so I memorialized accordingly—it was following Your Majesty's intent, not monopolizing authority."
translations.idiomatic: These two men had merit and ought to be given office, so I memorialized accordingly—it was following Your Majesty's intent, not monopolizing authority."

sentences.zh: 時太原圍未解，種師中戰沒，師道病歸，南仲曰：「欲援太原，非綱不可。

translations.literal: At that time the siege of Taiyuan was not yet lifted; Zhong Shizhong died in battle and Shidao returned home ill; Nanzhong said: "To relieve Taiyuan, none but Gang will do."
translations.idiomatic: At that time the siege of Taiyuan was not yet lifted; Zhong Shizhong died in battle and Shidao returned home ill; Nanzhong said, "To relieve Taiyuan, none but Gang will do."

sentences.zh: 」上以綱為河東、北宣撫使。

translations.literal: The emperor made Gang Pacification Commissioner for Hedong and Hebei North.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor made Gang Pacification Commissioner for Hedong and Hebei North.

sentences.zh: 綱言：「臣書生，實不知兵。

translations.literal: Gang said: "Your servant is a scholar and truly does not understand warfare."
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "Your servant is a scholar and truly does not understand warfare."

sentences.zh: 在圍城中，不得已為陛下料理兵事，今使為大帥，恐誤國事。

translations.literal: Within the besieged city I was compelled to manage military affairs for Your Majesty; now if I am made supreme commander, I fear I will ruin the affairs of state."
translations.idiomatic: Within the besieged city I was compelled to manage military affairs for Your Majesty; now if I am made supreme commander, I fear I will ruin the affairs of state."

sentences.zh: 」因拜辭，不許。

translations.literal: He bowed in refusal and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He bowed in refusal and was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 退而移疾，乞致仕，章十餘上，不允。

translations.literal: He withdrew and reported illness, requesting retirement; more than ten memorials were submitted and not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He withdrew and reported illness, requesting retirement; more than ten memorials were submitted and not permitted.

sentences.zh: 台諫言綱不可去朝廷，上以其為大臣遊說，斥之。

translations.literal: Censors and remonstrators said Gang must not leave the court; the emperor held that they were lobbying as great ministers and dismissed them.
translations.idiomatic: Censors and remonstrators said Gang must not leave the court; the emperor held that they were lobbying as great ministers and dismissed them.

sentences.zh: 或謂綱曰：「公知所以遣行之意乎？

translations.literal: Someone said to Gang: "Do you know the intent behind sending you on this mission?"
translations.idiomatic: Someone said to Gang, "Do you know the intent behind sending you on this mission?"

sentences.zh: 此非為邊事，欲緣此以去公，則都人無辭耳。

translations.literal: This is not for border affairs—it is intended by this means to remove you, so that the people of the capital will have no words."
translations.idiomatic: This is not for border affairs—it is intended by this means to remove you, so that the people of the capital will have no words."

sentences.zh: 公堅臥不起，讒者益肆，上怒且不測，奈何？

translations.literal: If you firmly remain in bed and do not rise, slanderers will grow bolder; the emperor's anger will be unpredictable—what then?"
translations.idiomatic: If you firmly remain in bed and do not rise, slanderers will grow bolder; the emperor's anger will be unpredictable—what then?"

sentences.zh: 」許翰書：「杜郵」二字遺綱，綱皇恐受命。

translations.literal: Xu Han sent a letter with the two characters "Du You"; Gang received the commission in fear and trembling.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Han sent a letter with the two characters "Du You"; Gang received the commission in fear and trembling.

sentences.zh: 上手書《裴度傳》以賜，綱言：「吳元濟以區區環蔡之地抗唐室，與金人強弱固不相侔，而臣曾不足以望裴度萬分之一。

translations.literal: The emperor personally wrote and bestowed the Biography of Pei Du; Gang said: "Wu Yuanji, with his mere ring of Cai lands, resisted the Tang house—the strength of the Jurchens is certainly not comparable; yet your servant cannot even hope to reach one ten-thousandth of Pei Du."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally wrote and bestowed the Biography of Pei Du. Gang said, "Wu Yuanji, with his mere ring of Cai lands, resisted the Tang house—the strength of the Jurchens is certainly not comparable; yet your servant cannot even hope to reach one ten-thousandth of Pei Du."

sentences.zh: 然寇攘外患可以掃除，小人在朝，蠹害難去。

translations.literal: Yet bandits and raiders, external calamities, can be swept away; petty men in court, the harm of the worm, are hard to remove.
translations.idiomatic: Yet bandits and raiders, external calamities, can be swept away; petty men in court, the harm of the worm, are hard to remove.

sentences.zh: 使朝廷既正，君子道長，則所以捍禦外患者，有不難也。

translations.literal: If the court is already rectified and the way of the superior man grows long, then defending against external calamities will not be difficult."
translations.idiomatic: If the court is already rectified and the way of the superior man grows long, then defending against external calamities will not be difficult."

sentences.zh: 」因書裴度論元稹、魏洪簡章疏要語以進，上優詔答之。

translations.literal: He therefore copied the essential passages of Pei Du's memorials on Yuan Zhen and Wei Hongjian and submitted them; the emperor replied with a gracious edict.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore copied the essential passages of Pei Du's memorials on Yuan Zhen and Wei Hongjian and submitted them; the emperor replied with a gracious edict.

sentences.zh: 宣撫司兵僅萬二千人，庶事未集，綱乞展行期。

translations.literal: The Pacification Commissioner's troops numbered only twelve thousand; many affairs were not yet gathered; Gang requested extension of the date of departure.
translations.idiomatic: The Pacification Commissioner's troops numbered only twelve thousand; many affairs were not yet gathered; Gang requested extension of the date of departure.

sentences.zh: 御批以為遷延拒命，綱上疏明其所以未可行者，且曰：「陛下前以臣為專權，今以臣為拒命，方遣大帥解重圍，而以專權、拒命之人為之，無乃不可乎？

translations.literal: The emperor's draft held this delay and refusal of orders; Gang submitted a memorial clarifying why he could not yet proceed, and said: "Your Majesty formerly held that your servant monopolized authority; now you hold that your servant refuses orders. When sending a supreme commander to relieve a critical siege, to appoint one accused of monopolizing authority and refusing orders—is this not impermissible?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's draft held this delay and refusal of orders. Gang submitted a memorial clarifying why he could not yet proceed, and said, "Your Majesty formerly held that your servant monopolized authority; now you hold that your servant refuses orders. When sending a supreme commander to relieve a critical siege, to appoint one accused of monopolizing authority and refusing orders—is this not impermissible?"

sentences.zh: 願乞骸骨，解樞管之任。

translations.literal: I request permission to retire and be released from duties at the Bureau of Military Affairs."
translations.idiomatic: I request permission to retire and be released from duties at the Bureau of Military Affairs."

sentences.zh: 」上趣召數四，曰：「卿為朕巡邊，便可還朝。

translations.literal: The emperor urgently summoned him four times, saying: "You shall patrol the border for me and then can return to court."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor urgently summoned him four times, saying, "You shall patrol the border for me and then can return to court."

sentences.zh: 」綱曰：「臣之行，無復還之理。

translations.literal: Gang said: "In your servant's going, there is no longer any principle of return."
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "In your servant's going, there is no longer any principle of return."

sentences.zh: 昔范仲淹以參政出撫西邊，過鄭州，見呂夷簡。

translations.literal: Formerly Fan Zhongyan, as participant in governance, went out to pacify the western border; passing Zhengzhou, he saw Lü Yijian.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Fan Zhongyan, as participant in governance, went out to pacify the western border; passing Zhengzhou, he saw Lü Yijian.

sentences.zh: 夷簡曰：'參政豈可復還！

translations.literal: Yijian said: 'Can a participant in governance return!'
translations.idiomatic: Yijian said, 'Can a participant in governance return!'

sentences.zh: '其後果然。

translations.literal: Afterward it was indeed so.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward it was indeed so.

sentences.zh: 今臣以愚直不容於朝，使既行之後，進而死敵，臣之願也。

translations.literal: Now your servant, because of foolish directness, is not tolerated at court; after I have gone, to advance and die against the enemy is your servant's wish."
translations.idiomatic: Now your servant, because of foolish directness, is not tolerated at court; after I have gone, to advance and die against the enemy is your servant's wish."

sentences.zh: 萬一朝廷執議不堅，臣當求去，陛下宜察臣孤忠，以全君臣之義。

translations.literal: If by any chance the court's deliberations are not firm and your servant must seek to leave, Your Majesty ought to discern your servant's solitary loyalty and complete the righteousness between ruler and minister."
translations.idiomatic: If by any chance the court's deliberations are not firm and your servant must seek to leave, Your Majesty ought to discern your servant's solitary loyalty and complete the righteousness between ruler and minister."

sentences.zh: 」上為之感動。

translations.literal: The emperor was moved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was moved.

sentences.zh: 及陛辭，言唐恪、聶山之奸，任之不已，後必誤國。

translations.literal: At his farewell audience he spoke of the treachery of Tang Que and Nie Shan; to employ them without end would afterward surely ruin the state.
translations.idiomatic: At his farewell audience he spoke of the treachery of Tang Que and Nie Shan; to employ them without end would afterward surely ruin the state.

sentences.zh: 進至河陽，望拜諸陵，復上奏曰：「臣總師出鞏、洛，望拜陵寢，潸然出涕。

translations.literal: Advancing to Heyang, he looked toward the tombs and bowed; he again submitted a memorial, saying: "Your servant, commanding the army, went out through Gong and Luo, looked toward the tombs and bowed, and tears flowed silently."
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to Heyang, he looked toward the tombs and bowed; he again submitted a memorial, saying, "Your servant, commanding the army, went out through Gong and Luo, looked toward the tombs and bowed, and tears flowed silently."

sentences.zh: 恭惟祖宗創業守成，垂二百年，以至陛下。

translations.literal: Respectfully considering that the ancestors founded, preserved, and handed down [the realm] for nearly two hundred years, down to Your Majesty,
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully considering that the ancestors founded, preserved, and handed down the realm for nearly two hundred years, down to Your Majesty,

sentences.zh: 適丁艱難之秋，強敵內侵，中國勢弱，此誠陛下嘗膽思報，厲精求治之日，願深考祖宗之法，一一推行之。

translations.literal: it has just met a time of peril; a strong enemy invades within; China's strength is weak—this is truly the day when Your Majesty ought to sleep on brushwood and taste gall, striving in spirit to seek good government.
translations.idiomatic: it has just met a time of peril; a strong enemy invades within; China's strength is weak—this is truly the day when Your Majesty ought to sleep on brushwood and taste gall, striving in spirit to seek good government.

sentences.zh: 進君子，退小人，益固邦本，以圖中興，上以慰安九廟之靈，下為億兆蒼生之所依賴，天下幸甚！」

translations.literal: I wish that you deeply examine the methods of the ancestors and carry them out one by one; advance superior men and retire petty men; further solidify the foundation of the state to plan restoration; above to comfort the spirits of the nine temples, below to be what the hundred millions rely on—great indeed would be the realm's fortune!"
translations.idiomatic: I wish that you deeply examine the methods of the ancestors and carry them out one by one; advance superior men and retire petty men; further solidify the foundation of the state to plan restoration; above to comfort the spirits of the nine temples, below to be what the hundred millions rely on—great indeed would be the realm's fortune!"

sentences.zh: 行次懷州，有詔罷減所起兵綱奏曰：「太原之圍未解，河東之勢甚危，秋高馬肥，敵必深入，宗社安危，殆未可知。

translations.literal: Stopping at Huaizhou, there was an edict disbanding and reducing the troops raised; Gang memorialized, saying: "The siege of Taiyuan is not yet lifted; the situation in Hedong is extremely perilous; when autumn is high and horses are fat, the enemy is certain to penetrate deeply; the safety of the altars of state is perhaps not yet known."
translations.idiomatic: Stopping at Huaizhou, there was an edict disbanding and reducing the troops raised. Gang memorialized, saying, "The siege of Taiyuan is not yet lifted; the situation in Hedong is extremely perilous; when autumn is high and horses are fat, the enemy is certain to penetrate deeply; the safety of the altars of state is perhaps not yet known."

sentences.zh: 使防秋之師果能足用，不可保無敵騎渡河之警。

translations.literal: Even if the troops for autumn defense can truly suffice, one cannot guarantee there will be no alarm of enemy cavalry crossing the river.
translations.idiomatic: Even if the troops for autumn defense can truly suffice, one cannot guarantee there will be no alarm of enemy cavalry crossing the river.

sentences.zh: 況臣出使未幾，朝廷盡改前詔，所團結之兵，悉罷減之。

translations.literal: Moreover, your servant has not long been on mission when the court has entirely changed the previous edicts; the troops that were assembled have all been disbanded and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, your servant has not long been on mission when the court has entirely changed the previous edicts; the troops that were assembled have all been disbanded and reduced.

sentences.zh: 今河北、河東日告危急，未有一人一騎以副其求，甫集之兵又皆散遣，臣誠不足以任此。

translations.literal: Now Hebei and Hedong daily report extreme peril, yet not a single man or horse is sent to meet their requests; the troops just gathered have again all been dispersed—your servant truly is not sufficient to undertake this.
translations.idiomatic: Now Hebei and Hedong daily report extreme peril, yet not a single man or horse is sent to meet their requests; the troops just gathered have again all been dispersed—your servant truly is not sufficient to undertake this.

sentences.zh: 且以軍法勒諸路起兵，而以寸紙罷之，臣恐後時有所號召，無復應者矣。

translations.literal: Moreover, to compel the circuits to raise troops by military law and then disband them with a slip of paper—I fear that hereafter when there is a call, none will again respond."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, to compel the circuits to raise troops by military law and then disband them with a slip of paper—I fear that hereafter when there is a call, none will again respond."

sentences.zh: 」疏上，不報。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted; there was no reply.

sentences.zh: 御批日促解太原之圍，而諸將承受禦畫，事皆專達，宣撫司徒有節制之名。

translations.literal: Imperial drafts daily pressed for lifting the siege of Taiyuan, yet the generals received the court's plans and all matters were reported directly; the Pacification Commissioner had only the name of control.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial drafts daily pressed for lifting the siege of Taiyuan, yet the generals received the court's plans and all matters were reported directly; the Pacification Commissioner had only the name of control.

sentences.zh: 綱上疏，極諫節制不專之弊。

translations.literal: Gang submitted a memorial strongly remonstrating against the harm of divided control.
translations.idiomatic: Gang submitted a memorial strongly remonstrating against the harm of divided control.

sentences.zh: 時方議和，詔止綱進兵。

translations.literal: At that time peace was being discussed; an edict ordered Gang not to advance his troops.
translations.idiomatic: At that time peace was being discussed; an edict ordered Gang not to advance his troops.

sentences.zh: 未幾，徐處仁、吳敏罷相而相唐恪，許翰罷同知樞密院而進聶山、陳過庭、李回等，吳敏復謫置涪州。

translations.literal: Before long, Xu Churen and Wu Min were dismissed as chief ministers and Tang Que became chief minister; Xu Han was dismissed as Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Nie Shan, Chen Guoting, Li Hui, and others were promoted; Wu Min was again demoted and sent to Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, Xu Churen and Wu Min were dismissed as chief ministers and Tang Que became chief minister; Xu Han was dismissed as Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Nie Shan, Chen Guoting, Li Hui, and others were promoted; Wu Min was again demoted and sent to Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 綱聞之，歎曰：「事無可為者矣！

translations.literal: When Gang heard this, he sighed and said: "There is nothing that can be done!"
translations.idiomatic: When Gang heard this, he sighed and said, "There is nothing that can be done!"

sentences.zh: 」即上奏丐罷。

translations.literal: He immediately submitted a memorial requesting dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately submitted a memorial requesting dismissal.

sentences.zh: 乃命種師道以同知樞密院事領宣撫司事，召綱赴闕。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zhong Shidao was ordered, as Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, to take charge of Pacification Commission affairs, and Gang was summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Zhong Shidao was ordered, as Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, to take charge of Pacification Commission affairs, and Gang was summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 尋除觀文殿學士、知揚州，綱具奏辭免。

translations.literal: Soon Gang was appointed Hanlin Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and Prefect of Yangzhou; he submitted a memorial declining.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Gang was appointed Hanlin Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and Prefect of Yangzhou; he submitted a memorial declining.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以綱專主戰議，喪師費財，落職提舉亳州明道宮，責授保靜軍節度副使，建昌軍安置；

translations.literal: Before long, because Gang had exclusively advocated war, lost troops and wasted resources, he was stripped of office and made Supervisor of the Mingdao Palace in Bozhou, demoted to Military Commissioner of the Baojing Army, and settled at Jianchang Army;
translations.idiomatic: Before long, because Gang had exclusively advocated war, lost troops and wasted resources, he was stripped of office and made Supervisor of the Mingdao Palace in Bozhou, demoted to Military Commissioner of the Baojing Army, and settled at Jianchang Army;

sentences.zh: 再謫甯江。

translations.literal: He was demoted again to Ningjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted again to Ningjiang.

sentences.zh: 金兵再至，上悟和議之非，除綱資政殿大學士，領開封府事。

translations.literal: When the Jurchen troops came again, the emperor realized the error of the peace talks and appointed Gang Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, in charge of Kaifeng Prefecture affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchen troops came again, the emperor realized the error of the peace talks and appointed Gang Grand Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance, in charge of Kaifeng Prefecture affairs.

sentences.zh: 綱行次長沙，被命，即率湖南勤王之師入援，未至而都城失守。
