translations.literal: Gang, stopping at Changsha, received the order and immediately led Hunan's armies coming to rescue the throne to enter in relief; before he arrived the capital fell.
translations.idiomatic: Gang, stopping at Changsha, received the order and immediately led Hunan's armies coming to rescue the throne to enter in relief; before he arrived the capital fell.

sentences.zh: 先是，康王至北軍，為金人所憚，求遣肅王代之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Prince Kang reached the northern army, the Jurchens feared him and requested that Prince Su replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Prince Kang reached the northern army, the Jurchens feared him and requested that Prince Su replace him.

sentences.zh: 至是，康王開大元帥府，承制復綱故官，且貽書曰：「方今生民之命，急於倒垂，諒非不世之才，何以協濟事功。

translations.literal: By this time Prince Kang opened the Grand Marshal's headquarters, assumed authority by imperial order to restore Gang's former office, and also sent a letter saying: "At present the lives of the people are more urgent than one hanging upside down; surely none but an uncommon talent can jointly achieve the work."
translations.idiomatic: By this time Prince Kang opened the Grand Marshal's headquarters, assumed authority by imperial order to restore Gang's former office, and also sent a letter saying, "At present the lives of the people are more urgent than one hanging upside down; surely none but an uncommon talent can jointly achieve the work."

sentences.zh: 閣下學窮天人，忠貫金石，當投袂而起，以副蒼生之望。」

translations.literal: Your learning exhausts Heaven and man; your loyalty pierces metal and stone—you ought to rouse yourself and act, to fulfill what the dark-haired masses hope for."
translations.idiomatic: Your learning exhausts Heaven and man; your loyalty pierces metal and stone—you ought to rouse yourself and act, to fulfill what the dark-haired masses hope for."

sentences.zh: 高宗即位，拜尚書右僕射兼中書侍郎，趣赴闕。

translations.literal: When Emperor Gaozong took the throne, Gang was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with concurrent appointment as Vice Director of the Secretariat, and was urgently summoned to court.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Gaozong took the throne, Gang was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with concurrent appointment as Vice Director of the Secretariat, and was urgently summoned to court.

sentences.zh: 中丞顏岐奏曰：「張邦昌為金人所喜，雖已為三公、郡王，宜更加同平章事，增重其禮；

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Yan Qi memorialized, saying: "Zhang Bangchang is favored by the Jurchens; although he has already been made Three Excellencies and a prince of a commandery, he ought further to be made Associate Grand Councilor to increase his honors;
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Yan Qi memorialized, saying, "Zhang Bangchang is favored by the Jurchens; although he has already been made Three Excellencies and a prince of a commandery, he ought further to be made Associate Grand Councilor to increase his honors;

sentences.zh: 李綱為金人所惡，雖已命相，宜及其未至罷之。

translations.literal: Li Gang is hated by the Jurchens; although he has already been ordered made chief minister, he ought, before he arrives, to be dismissed."
translations.idiomatic: Li Gang is hated by the Jurchens; although he has already been ordered made chief minister, he ought, before he arrives, to be dismissed."

sentences.zh: 」章五上，上曰：「如朕之立，恐亦非金人所喜。

translations.literal: He submitted the memorial five times; the emperor said: "As for my being established, I fear the Jurchens are also not pleased."
translations.idiomatic: He submitted the memorial five times; the emperor said, "As for my being established, I fear the Jurchens are also not pleased."

sentences.zh: 」岐語塞而退。

translations.literal: Qi was silenced and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Qi was silenced and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 岐猶遣人封其章示綱，覬以沮其來。

translations.literal: Qi still sent someone to seal his memorial and show it to Gang, hoping thereby to discourage his coming.
translations.idiomatic: Qi still sent someone to seal his memorial and show it to Gang, hoping thereby to discourage his coming.

sentences.zh: 上聞綱且至，遣官迎勞，錫宴，趣見於內殿。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard that Gang was about to arrive, he sent officials to welcome and comfort him, granted a banquet, and urged audience in the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard that Gang was about to arrive, he sent officials to welcome and comfort him, granted a banquet, and urged audience in the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 綱見上，涕泗交集，上為動容。

translations.literal: When Gang saw the emperor, tears and mucus mingled; the emperor was moved.
translations.idiomatic: When Gang saw the emperor, tears and mucus mingled; the emperor was moved.

sentences.zh: 因奏曰：「金人不道，專以詐謀取勝，中國不悟，一切墮其計中。

translations.literal: He therefore memorialized, saying: "The Jurchens are without the Way and rely exclusively on deceitful stratagems to win; China did not understand and entirely fell into their schemes."
translations.idiomatic: He therefore memorialized, saying, "The Jurchens are without the Way and rely exclusively on deceitful stratagems to win; China did not understand and entirely fell into their schemes."

sentences.zh: 賴天命未改，陛下總師于外，為天下臣民之所推戴，內修外攘，還二聖而撫萬邦，責在陛下與宰相。

translations.literal: Fortunately Heaven's mandate has not changed; Your Majesty commands armies abroad and is pushed forward by the officials and people of the realm; within, cultivate and without, repel—restore the Two Emperors and pacify the myriad states; the responsibility lies with Your Majesty and the chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Fortunately Heaven's mandate has not changed; Your Majesty commands armies abroad and is pushed forward by the officials and people of the realm; within, cultivate and without, repel—restore the Two Emperors and pacify the myriad states; the responsibility lies with Your Majesty and the chief minister.

sentences.zh: 臣自視闕然，不足以副陛下委任之意，乞追寢成命。

translations.literal: Your servant views himself as deficient and is not sufficient to fulfill Your Majesty's intent in entrusting him; I request that the completed appointment be withdrawn."
translations.idiomatic: Your servant views himself as deficient and is not sufficient to fulfill Your Majesty's intent in entrusting him; I request that the completed appointment be withdrawn."

sentences.zh: 且臣在道，顏岐嘗封示論臣章，謂臣為金人所惡，不當為相。

translations.literal: Moreover, while your servant was on the road, Yan Qi once sealed and showed me a memorial discussing your servant, saying your servant is hated by the Jurchens and ought not be made chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, while your servant was on the road, Yan Qi once sealed and showed me a memorial discussing your servant, saying your servant is hated by the Jurchens and ought not be made chief minister.

sentences.zh: 如臣愚蠢，但知有趙氏，不知有金人，宜為所惡。

translations.literal: As for your servant's foolishness, I know only the Zhao house and do not know the Jurchens—it is fitting that I be hated.
translations.idiomatic: As for your servant's foolishness, I know only the Zhao house and do not know the Jurchens—it is fitting that I be hated.

sentences.zh: 然謂臣材不足以任宰相則可，謂為金人所惡不當為相則不可。

translations.literal: Yet to say your servant's talent is insufficient to undertake the chief ministership is acceptable; to say that because the Jurchens hate him he ought not be chief minister is not acceptable."
translations.idiomatic: Yet to say your servant's talent is insufficient to undertake the chief ministership is acceptable; to say that because the Jurchens hate him he ought not be chief minister is not acceptable."

sentences.zh: 」因力辭。

translations.literal: He forcefully declined.
translations.idiomatic: He forcefully declined.

sentences.zh: 帝為出范宗尹知舒州。

translations.literal: The emperor sent out Fan Zongyin as Prefect of Shuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent out Fan Zongyin as Prefect of Shuzhou.

sentences.zh: 顏岐與祠。

translations.literal: Yan Qi was granted a leave for sacrificial offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Qi was granted a leave for sacrificial offerings.

sentences.zh: 綱猶力辭，上曰：「朕知卿忠義智略久矣，欲使敵國畏服，四方安寧，非相卿不可，卿其勿辭。

translations.literal: Gang still forcefully declined; the emperor said: "I have long known your loyalty, righteousness, wisdom, and strategy; to make the enemy state fear and submit and the four quarters peaceful—none but you as chief minister will do; do not decline."
translations.idiomatic: Gang still forcefully declined; the emperor said, "I have long known your loyalty, righteousness, wisdom, and strategy; to make the enemy state fear and submit and the four quarters peaceful—none but you as chief minister will do; do not decline."

sentences.zh: 」綱頓首泣謝，云：

translations.literal: Gang bowed his head, wept, and thanked him, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Gang bowed his head, wept, and thanked him, saying,

sentences.zh: 臣愚陋無取，荷陛下知遇，然今日扶顛持危，圖中興之功，在陛下而不在臣。

translations.literal: Your servant is foolish and coarse and has nothing to recommend him; I receive Your Majesty's gracious recognition; yet today's task of upholding what is overturned, sustaining what is perilous, and achieving restoration lies with Your Majesty and not with your servant.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant is foolish and coarse and has nothing to recommend him; I receive Your Majesty's gracious recognition; yet today's task of upholding what is overturned, sustaining what is perilous, and achieving restoration lies with Your Majesty and not with your servant.

sentences.zh: 臣無左右先容，陛下首加識擢，付以宰柄，顧區區何足以仰副圖任責成之意？

translations.literal: Your servant has no one at left or right to speak for him; Your Majesty first added recognition and bestowed the handle of government—how can this petty person hope to fulfill the intent of entrusting and completing the task?
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has no one at left or right to speak for him; Your Majesty first added recognition and bestowed the handle of government—how can this petty person hope to fulfill the intent of entrusting and completing the task?

sentences.zh: 然「靡不有初，鮮克有終」。

translations.literal: Yet 'there is hardly anything without a beginning, but rarely is there an end.'
translations.idiomatic: Yet 'there is hardly anything without a beginning, but rarely is there an end.'

sentences.zh: 臣孤立寡與，望察管仲害霸之言，留神于君子小人之間，使得以盡志畢慮，雖死無憾。

translations.literal: Your servant stands alone with few allies; I hope Your Majesty will observe Guan Zhong's words on what harms hegemony and keep your mind on the distinction between superior men and petty men, so that I may exhaust my will and complete my plans—even in death I will have no regret.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant stands alone with few allies; I hope Your Majesty will observe Guan Zhong's words on what harms hegemony and keep your mind on the distinction between superior men and petty men, so that I may exhaust my will and complete my plans—even in death I will have no regret.

sentences.zh: 昔唐明皇欲相姚崇，崇以十事要說，皆中一時之病。

translations.literal: Formerly when Emperor Ming of Tang wished to appoint Yao Chong chief minister, Chong required ten conditions and all hit the ills of the time.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly when Emperor Ming of Tang wished to appoint Yao Chong chief minister, Chong required ten conditions and all hit the ills of the time.

sentences.zh: 今臣亦以十事仰幹天聽，陛下度其可行者，賜之施行，臣乃敢受命。

translations.literal: Now your servant also presents ten matters to Your Majesty's hearing; if Your Majesty measures what can be carried out and grants implementation, then your servant dares accept the commission.
translations.idiomatic: Now your servant also presents ten matters to Your Majesty's hearing; if Your Majesty measures what can be carried out and grants implementation, then your servant dares accept the commission.

sentences.zh: 一曰議國是。

translations.literal: First: Deliberate the national policy.
translations.idiomatic: First: Deliberate the national policy.

sentences.zh: 謂中國之禦四裔，能守而後可戰，能戰而後可和，而靖康之末皆失之。

translations.literal: In China's defense against the four frontier peoples, one can fight only after one can hold, and one can make peace only after one can fight—and at the end of Jingkang all were lost.
translations.idiomatic: In China's defense against the four frontier peoples, one can fight only after one can hold, and one can make peace only after one can fight—and at the end of Jingkang all were lost.

sentences.zh: 今欲戰則不足，欲和則不可，莫若先自治，專以守為策，俟吾政事修，士氣振，然後可議大舉。

translations.literal: Now if we wish to fight we are insufficient; if we wish peace it is impossible; better first to govern ourselves, exclusively taking defense as the strategy, and wait until our government affairs are improved and morale raised—then we can deliberate a great campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Now if we wish to fight we are insufficient; if we wish peace it is impossible; better first to govern ourselves, exclusively taking defense as the strategy, and wait until our government affairs are improved and morale raised—then we can deliberate a great campaign.

sentences.zh: 二曰議巡幸。

translations.literal: Second: Deliberate the imperial tour.
translations.idiomatic: Second: Deliberate the imperial tour.

sentences.zh: 謂車駕不可不一到京師，見宗廟，以慰都人之心，度未可居，則為巡幸之計。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage cannot but once reach the capital and see the ancestral temples, to comfort the hearts of the people of the capital; estimating that it cannot yet be dwelt in, then make plans for an imperial tour.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage cannot but once reach the capital and see the ancestral temples, to comfort the hearts of the people of the capital; estimating that it cannot yet be dwelt in, then make plans for an imperial tour.

sentences.zh: 以天下形勢而觀。

translations.literal: Viewing the realm's strategic situation,
translations.idiomatic: Viewing the realm's strategic situation,

sentences.zh: 長安為上，襄陽次之，建康又次之，皆當詔有司預為之備。

translations.literal: Chang'an is first, Xiangyang second, Jiankang third—all ought to be ordered that the relevant offices prepare in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Chang'an is first, Xiangyang second, Jiankang third—all ought to be ordered that the relevant offices prepare in advance.

sentences.zh: 三日議赦令。

translations.literal: Third: Deliberate amnesty edicts.
translations.idiomatic: Third: Deliberate amnesty edicts.

sentences.zh: 謂祖宗登極赦令，皆有常式。

translations.literal: The amnesty edicts of the ancestors upon accession all had fixed forms.
translations.idiomatic: The amnesty edicts of the ancestors upon accession all had fixed forms.

sentences.zh: 前日赦書，乃以張邦昌偽赦為法，如赦惡逆及罪廢官盡復官職，皆氾濫不可行，宜悉改正以法。

translations.literal: The recent amnesty edict took Zhang Bangchang's false amnesty as its model—such as pardoning traitors and restoring to office all who had been dismissed for crimes—all were excessive and cannot be carried out; all ought to be corrected according to law.
translations.idiomatic: The recent amnesty edict took Zhang Bangchang's false amnesty as its model—such as pardoning traitors and restoring to office all who had been dismissed for crimes—all were excessive and cannot be carried out; all ought to be corrected according to law.

sentences.zh: 四曰議僭逆。

translations.literal: Fourth: Deliberate usurpation and treason.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: Deliberate usurpation and treason.

sentences.zh: 謂張邦昌為國大臣，不能臨難死節，而挾金人之勢易姓改號，宜正典刑，垂戒萬世。

translations.literal: Zhang Bangchang was a great minister of the state; he could not face peril and die maintaining integrity, but relied on Jurchen power to change the surname and reign title—he ought to receive the standard punishment and be a warning for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Bangchang was a great minister of the state; he could not face peril and die maintaining integrity, but relied on Jurchen power to change the surname and reign title—he ought to receive the standard punishment and be a warning for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 五曰議偽命。

translations.literal: Fifth: Deliberate false appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: Deliberate false appointments.

sentences.zh: 謂國家更大變，鮮仗節死義之士，而受偽官以屈膝於其庭者，不可勝數。

translations.literal: The state underwent a great change; few upheld integrity and died for righteousness, while those who accepted false office and bowed the knee in their court cannot be counted.
translations.idiomatic: The state underwent a great change; few upheld integrity and died for righteousness, while those who accepted false office and bowed the knee in their court cannot be counted.

sentences.zh: 昔肅宗平賊，汙為偽者以六等定罪，宜仿之以勵士風。

translations.literal: Formerly when Emperor Suzong pacified the rebels, those defiled by serving the false were sentenced in six grades—one ought to imitate this to encourage scholarly morale.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly when Emperor Suzong pacified the rebels, those defiled by serving the false were sentenced in six grades—one ought to imitate this to encourage scholarly morale.

sentences.zh: 六曰議戰。

translations.literal: Sixth: Deliberate warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth: Deliberate warfare.

sentences.zh: 謂軍政久廢，士氣怯惰，宜一新紀律，信賞必罰，以作其氣。

translations.literal: Military government has long been abandoned; morale is timid and slack; one ought to renew discipline, reward and punish with certainty, to rouse their spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Military government has long been abandoned; morale is timid and slack; one ought to renew discipline, reward and punish with certainty, to rouse their spirit.

sentences.zh: 七曰議守。

translations.literal: Seventh: Deliberate defense.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh: Deliberate defense.

sentences.zh: 謂敵情狡獪，勢必復來，宜於沿河、江、淮措置控禦，以扼其沖。

translations.literal: The enemy's disposition is cunning and crafty; they are certain to return; one ought along the Yellow River, Yangtze, and Huai to arrange control and defense to choke their thrust.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy's disposition is cunning and crafty; they are certain to return; one ought along the Yellow River, Yangtze, and Huai to arrange control and defense to choke their thrust.

sentences.zh: 八曰議本政。

translations.literal: Eighth: Deliberate fundamental government.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth: Deliberate fundamental government.

sentences.zh: 謂政出多門，紀綱紊亂，宜一歸之於中書，則朝廷尊。

translations.literal: Government issues from many gates; discipline is disordered; all ought to be returned to the Secretariat—then the court will be honored.
translations.idiomatic: Government issues from many gates; discipline is disordered; all ought to be returned to the Secretariat—then the court will be honored.

sentences.zh: 九曰議久任。

translations.literal: Ninth: Deliberate long tenure.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth: Deliberate long tenure.

sentences.zh: 謂靖康間進退大臣太速，功效蔑著，宜慎擇而久任之，以責成功。

translations.literal: During Jingkang, advancement and dismissal of great ministers was too rapid and achievements were not evident; one ought carefully to select and long employ them, charging them with success.
translations.idiomatic: During Jingkang, advancement and dismissal of great ministers was too rapid and achievements were not evident; one ought carefully to select and long employ them, charging them with success.

sentences.zh: 十曰議修德。

translations.literal: Tenth: Deliberate cultivating virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth: Deliberate cultivating virtue.

sentences.zh: 謂上始膺天命，宜益修孝悌恭儉，以副四海之望，而致中興。

translations.literal: Your Majesty has just received Heaven's mandate; you ought further to cultivate filial piety, brotherliness, respect, and frugality, to fulfill the hopes of the four seas and achieve restoration.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has just received Heaven's mandate; you ought further to cultivate filial piety, brotherliness, respect, and frugality, to fulfill the hopes of the four seas and achieve restoration.

sentences.zh: 翌日，班綱議於朝，惟僭逆、偽命二事留中不出。

translations.literal: The next day Gang's deliberations were announced at court; only the two matters of usurpation and false appointments were kept within and not issued.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Gang's deliberations were announced at court; only the two matters of usurpation and false appointments were kept within and not issued.

sentences.zh: 綱言：

translations.literal: Gang said:
translations.idiomatic: Gang said,

sentences.zh: 夫都城之人德邦昌，謂因其立而得生，且免重科金銀之擾。

translations.literal: The people of the capital are grateful to Bangchang, holding that because he was established they obtained life and were spared heavy levies of gold and silver.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the capital are grateful to Bangchang, holding that because he was established they obtained life and were spared heavy levies of gold and silver.

sentences.zh: 元帥府恕邦昌，謂其不待征討而遣使奉迎。

translations.literal: The Marshal's headquarters forgave Bangchang, holding that without awaiting punitive expedition he sent envoys to welcome [the emperor].
translations.idiomatic: The Marshal's headquarters forgave Bangchang, holding that without awaiting punitive expedition he sent envoys to welcome the emperor.

sentences.zh: 若天下之憤嫉邦昌者，則謂其建號易姓，而奉迎特出於不得已。

translations.literal: As for those throughout the realm who resent Bangchang, they hold that he established a reign title and changed the surname, while welcoming [the emperor] was only from unavoidable necessity.
translations.idiomatic: As for those throughout the realm who resent Bangchang, they hold that he established a reign title and changed the surname, while welcoming the emperor was only from unavoidable necessity.

sentences.zh: 都城德之，元帥府恕之，私也，天下憤嫉之，公也。

translations.literal: The capital's gratitude and the Marshal's headquarters' forgiveness are private; the realm's resentment is public.
translations.idiomatic: The capital's gratitude and the Marshal's headquarters' forgiveness are private; the realm's resentment is public.

sentences.zh: 《春秋》之法，人臣無將，將而必誅；

translations.literal: The method of the Spring and Autumn Annals: if a minister has the intent of rebellion, once he rebels he must be executed;
translations.idiomatic: The method of the Spring and Autumn Annals: if a minister has the intent of rebellion, once he rebels he must be executed;

sentences.zh: 趙盾不討賊，則書以殺君。

translations.literal: Zhao Dun did not punish the assassin, and therefore it is written that he killed his lord.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Dun did not punish the assassin, and therefore it is written that he killed his lord.

sentences.zh: 今邦昌已僭位號，敵退而止勤王之師，非特將與不討賊而已。

translations.literal: Now Bangchang has already usurped title and rank, and when the enemy withdrew he stopped the armies coming to rescue the throne—not merely having the intent and not punishing the assassin.
translations.idiomatic: Now Bangchang has already usurped title and rank, and when the enemy withdrew he stopped the armies coming to rescue the throne—not merely having the intent and not punishing the assassin.

sentences.zh: 劉盆子以漢宗室為赤眉所立，其後以十萬眾降光武，但待之以不死。

translations.literal: Liu Penzi, as a member of the Han imperial house, was established by the Red Eyebrows; afterward with one hundred thousand men he surrendered to Emperor Guangwu and was only treated with exemption from death.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Penzi, as a member of the Han imperial house, was established by the Red Eyebrows; afterward with one hundred thousand men he surrendered to Emperor Guangwu and was only treated with exemption from death.

sentences.zh: 邦昌以臣易君，罪大於盆子，不得已而自歸，朝廷既不正其罪，又尊崇之，此何理也？

translations.literal: Bangchang, as a minister replacing his lord, his crime is greater than Penzi's; he returned of unavoidable necessity, yet the court neither corrected his crime nor honored him—what principle is this?
translations.idiomatic: Bangchang, as a minister replacing his lord, his crime is greater than Penzi's; he returned of unavoidable necessity, yet the court neither corrected his crime nor honored him—what principle is this?

sentences.zh: 陛下欲建中興之業，而尊崇僭逆之臣，以示四方，其誰不解體？

translations.literal: Your Majesty wishes to establish the enterprise of restoration, yet honors a usurping and treasonous minister to show the four quarters—who will not lose heart?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty wishes to establish the enterprise of restoration, yet honors a usurping and treasonous minister to show the four quarters—who will not lose heart?

sentences.zh: 又偽命臣僚，一切置而不問，何以厲天下士大夫之節？

translations.literal: Moreover, false-appointed officials are all set aside without inquiry—how can the integrity of scholars and officials throughout the realm be encouraged?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, false-appointed officials are all set aside without inquiry—how can the integrity of scholars and officials throughout the realm be encouraged?

sentences.zh: 時執政中有論不同者，上乃召黃潛善等語之。

translations.literal: At that time among those in power there were differing views; the emperor therefore summoned Huang Qianshan and others to discuss it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time among those in power there were differing views; the emperor therefore summoned Huang Qianshan and others to discuss it.

sentences.zh: 潛善主邦昌甚力，上顧呂好問曰：「卿昨在圍城中知其故，以為何如？

translations.literal: Qianshan strongly advocated for Bangchang; the emperor turned to Lü Haowen and said: "You were in the besieged city yesterday and know the reason—what do you think?"
translations.idiomatic: Qianshan strongly advocated for Bangchang; the emperor turned to Lü Haowen and said, "You were in the besieged city yesterday and know the reason—what do you think?"

sentences.zh: 」好問附潛善，持兩端，曰：「邦昌僭竊位號，人所共知，既已自歸，惟陛下裁處。

translations.literal: Haowen sided with Qianshan, holding both ends, and said: "Bangchang's usurpation of title and rank is known to all; since he has already returned of his own accord, let Your Majesty decide."
translations.idiomatic: Haowen sided with Qianshan, holding both ends, and said, "Bangchang's usurpation of title and rank is known to all; since he has already returned of his own accord, let Your Majesty decide."

sentences.zh: 」綱言：「邦昌僭逆，豈可使之在朝廷，使道路指目曰'此亦一天子'哉！

translations.literal: Gang said: "Bangchang usurped and rebelled—how can he be kept at court, so that travelers point and say 'There is also an emperor'?"
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "Bangchang usurped and rebelled—how can he be kept at court, so that travelers point and say 'There is also an emperor'?"

sentences.zh: 」因泣拜曰：「臣不可與邦昌同列，當以笏擊之。

translations.literal: He therefore wept and bowed, saying: "Your servant cannot sit in the same row as Bangchang—I shall strike him with my tablet."
translations.idiomatic: He therefore wept and bowed, saying, "Your servant cannot sit in the same row as Bangchang—I shall strike him with my tablet."

sentences.zh: 陛下必欲用邦昌，第罷臣。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty insists on employing Bangchang, dismiss your servant only."
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty insists on employing Bangchang, dismiss your servant only."

sentences.zh: 」上頗感動。

translations.literal: The emperor was somewhat moved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was somewhat moved.

sentences.zh: 伯彥乃曰：「李綱氣直，臣等所不及。

translations.literal: Boyan then said: "Li Gang's spirit is direct—we cannot match him."
translations.idiomatic: Boyan then said, "Li Gang's spirit is direct—we cannot match him."

sentences.zh: 」乃詔邦昌謫潭州，吳幵、莫儔而下皆遷謫有差。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict demoted Bangchang to Tanzhou; Wu Qian, Mo Chou, and those below were all transferred and demoted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon an edict demoted Bangchang to Tanzhou; Wu Qian, Mo Chou, and those below were all transferred and demoted in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 綱又言：「近世士大夫寡廉鮮恥，不知君臣之義。

translations.literal: Gang also said: "In recent times scholars and officials have lacked integrity and shame and do not know the righteousness between ruler and minister.
translations.idiomatic: Gang also said, "In recent times scholars and officials have lacked integrity and shame and do not know the righteousness between ruler and minister.

sentences.zh: 靖康之禍，能仗節死義者，在內惟李若水，在外惟霍安國，願加贈恤。

translations.literal: In the calamity of Jingkang, those who could uphold integrity and die for righteousness—within there was only Li Ruoshui, abroad only Huo Anguo—I wish that additional posthumous honors be granted."
translations.idiomatic: In the calamity of Jingkang, those who could uphold integrity and die for righteousness—within there was only Li Ruoshui, abroad only Huo Anguo—I wish that additional posthumous honors be granted."

sentences.zh: 」上從其請，仍詔有死節者，諸路詢訪以聞。

translations.literal: The emperor followed his request and also ordered that for those who died maintaining integrity, the circuits should inquire and report.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed his request and also ordered that for those who died maintaining integrity, the circuits should inquire and report.

sentences.zh: 上謂綱曰：「卿昨爭張邦昌事，內侍輩皆泣涕，卿今可以受命矣。

translations.literal: The emperor said to Gang: "Yesterday when you contended over Zhang Bangchang, the eunuchs all wept; you can now accept the commission."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to Gang, "Yesterday when you contended over Zhang Bangchang, the eunuchs all wept; you can now accept the commission."

sentences.zh: 」綱拜謝。

translations.literal: Gang bowed in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: Gang bowed in thanks.

sentences.zh: 有旨兼充禦營使。

translations.literal: An edict additionally made him Commissioner of the Imperial Camp.
translations.idiomatic: An edict additionally made him Commissioner of the Imperial Camp.

sentences.zh: 入對，奏曰：

translations.literal: Entering in audience, he memorialized, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Entering in audience, he memorialized, saying,

sentences.zh: 今國勢不逮靖康間遠甚，然而可為者，陛下英斷于上，群臣輯睦於下，庶幾靖康之弊革，而中興可圖。

translations.literal: Today's national strength is far inferior to the Jingkang period; yet what can be done is that Your Majesty is decisively brilliant above and the ministers are harmonious below—then perhaps the ills of Jingkang can be reformed and restoration can be planned.
translations.idiomatic: Today's national strength is far inferior to the Jingkang period; yet what can be done is that Your Majesty is decisively brilliant above and the ministers are harmonious below—then perhaps the ills of Jingkang can be reformed and restoration can be planned.

sentences.zh: 然非有規模而知先後緩急之序，則不能以成功。

translations.literal: Yet unless there is a comprehensive plan and knowledge of the order of priority and urgency, success cannot be achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Yet unless there is a comprehensive plan and knowledge of the order of priority and urgency, success cannot be achieved.

sentences.zh: 夫外禦強敵，內銷盜賊，修軍政，變士風，裕邦財，寬民力，改弊法，省冗官，誠號令以感人心，信賞罰以作士氣，擇帥臣以任方面，選監司、郡守以奉行新政，俟吾所以自治者政事已修，然後可以問罪金人，迎還二聖，此所謂規模也。

translations.literal: Outwardly repel the strong enemy, inwardly suppress bandits, reform military government, transform scholarly morale, enrich the state's finances, lighten the people's burdens, change corrupt laws, reduce redundant officials, make commands sincere to move hearts, make rewards and punishments trustworthy to rouse morale, select commanders to entrust with regions, choose surveillance commissioners and prefects to carry out the new government—wait until what we use to govern ourselves, government affairs, is improved, then we can call the Jurchens to account, restore the Two Emperors—this is what is called the comprehensive plan.
translations.idiomatic: Outwardly repel the strong enemy, inwardly suppress bandits, reform military government, transform scholarly morale, enrich the state's finances, lighten the people's burdens, change corrupt laws, reduce redundant officials, make commands sincere to move hearts, make rewards and punishments trustworthy to rouse morale, select commanders to entrust with regions, choose surveillance commissioners and prefects to carry out the new government—wait until what we use to govern ourselves, government affairs, is improved, then we can call the Jurchens to account, restore the Two Emperors—this is what is called the comprehensive plan.

sentences.zh: 至於所當急而先者，則在於料理河北、河東。

translations.literal: As for what ought to be urgent and first, it lies in managing Hebei and Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: As for what ought to be urgent and first, it lies in managing Hebei and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 蓋河北、河東者，國之遮罩也。

translations.literal: For Hebei and Hedong are the realm's shield.
translations.idiomatic: For Hebei and Hedong are the realm's shield.

sentences.zh: 料理稍就，然後中原可保，而東南可安。

translations.literal: When management is somewhat accomplished, then the Central Plain can be preserved and the southeast can be secure.
translations.idiomatic: When management is somewhat accomplished, then the Central Plain can be preserved and the southeast can be secure.

sentences.zh: 今河東所失者忻、代、太原、澤、潞、汾、晉，餘郡猶存也。

translations.literal: Now in Hedong what is lost is Xin, Dai, Taiyuan, Ze, Lu, Fen, and Jin—the remaining prefectures still remain.
translations.idiomatic: Now in Hedong what is lost is Xin, Dai, Taiyuan, Ze, Lu, Fen, and Jin—the remaining prefectures still remain.

sentences.zh: 河北所失者，不過真定、懷、衛、浚四州而已，其餘三十餘郡，皆為朝廷守。

translations.literal: In Hebei what is lost is no more than the four prefectures of Zhending, Huai, Wei, and Jun—the remaining thirty-odd prefectures are all held for the court.
translations.idiomatic: In Hebei what is lost is no more than the four prefectures of Zhending, Huai, Wei, and Jun—the remaining thirty-odd prefectures are all held for the court.

sentences.zh: 兩路士民兵將，所以戴宋者，其心甚堅，皆推豪傑以為首領，多者數萬，少者亦不下萬人。

translations.literal: The scholar-officials, civilians, and generals of the two circuits who bear the Song on their hearts are very firm in mind; all push forward heroes as leaders—many number tens of thousands, few fall short of ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The scholar-officials, civilians, and generals of the two circuits who bear the Song on their hearts are very firm in mind; all push forward heroes as leaders—many number tens of thousands, few fall short of ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 朝廷不因此時置司、遣使以大慰撫之，分兵以援其危急，臣恐糧盡力疲，坐受金人之困。

translations.literal: If the court does not at this time establish offices and send envoys greatly to comfort and reassure them, and divide troops to aid their critical peril, I fear when grain is exhausted and strength spent they will sit and receive the Jurchens' constraint.
translations.idiomatic: If the court does not at this time establish offices and send envoys greatly to comfort and reassure them, and divide troops to aid their critical peril, I fear when grain is exhausted and strength spent they will sit and receive the Jurchens' constraint.

sentences.zh: 雖懷忠義之心，援兵不至，危迫無告，必且憤怨朝廷，金人因得撫而用之，皆精兵也。

translations.literal: Though they cherish loyal and righteous hearts, if relief armies do not arrive and they are critically pressed with none to appeal to, they will surely resent the court; the Jurchens will thereby win them over and employ them—all are elite troops.
translations.idiomatic: Though they cherish loyal and righteous hearts, if relief armies do not arrive and they are critically pressed with none to appeal to, they will surely resent the court; the Jurchens will thereby win them over and employ them—all are elite troops.

sentences.zh: 莫若于河北置招撫司，河東置經制司，擇有材略者為之使，宣論天子恩德、所以不忍棄兩河於敵國之意。

translations.literal: Better to establish a Pacification Office in Hebei and a Control Office in Hedong, selecting men of talent and strategy to serve as commissioners, proclaiming the Son of Heaven's grace and the intent of unwillingness to abandon the two rivers to the enemy state.
translations.idiomatic: Better to establish a Pacification Office in Hebei and a Control Office in Hedong, selecting men of talent and strategy to serve as commissioners, proclaiming the Son of Heaven's grace and the intent of unwillingness to abandon the two rivers to the enemy state.

sentences.zh: 有能全一州、復一郡者，以為節度、防禦、團練使，如唐方鎮之制，使自為守。

translations.literal: Whoever can preserve one prefecture or recover one commandery shall be made military commissioner, defense commissioner, or training commissioner, after the Tang frontier garrison system, letting them hold their own defense.
translations.idiomatic: Whoever can preserve one prefecture or recover one commandery shall be made military commissioner, defense commissioner, or training commissioner, after the Tang frontier garrison system, letting them hold their own defense.

sentences.zh: 非惟絕其從敵之心，又可資其禦敵之力，使朝廷永無北顧之憂，最今日之先務也。

translations.literal: Not only will this cut off their hearts from following the enemy, but it can also supply their strength for resisting the enemy, so that the court forever has no worry of looking north—this is today's most urgent task.
translations.idiomatic: Not only will this cut off their hearts from following the enemy, but it can also supply their strength for resisting the enemy, so that the court forever has no worry of looking north—this is today's most urgent task.

sentences.zh: 上善其言，問誰可任者，綱薦張所、傅亮。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words and asked who could be entrusted; Gang recommended Zhang Suo and Fu Liang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his words and asked who could be entrusted; Gang recommended Zhang Suo and Fu Liang.

sentences.zh: 所嘗為監察御史，在靖康圍城中，以蠟書募河北兵，士民得書，喜曰：「朝廷棄我，猶有一張察院能拔而用之。

translations.literal: Suo had formerly served as Investigating Censor; within the Jingkang siege he used wax-sealed letters to recruit Hebei troops; when scholars and civilians received the letters they rejoiced, saying: "The court has abandoned us, yet there is still one Inspector Zhang who can pull us out and employ us."
translations.idiomatic: Suo had formerly served as Investigating Censor; within the Jingkang siege he used wax-sealed letters to recruit Hebei troops; when scholars and civilians received the letters they rejoiced, saying, "The court has abandoned us, yet there is still one Inspector Zhang who can pull us out and employ us."

sentences.zh: 」應募者凡十七萬人，由是所之聲震河北。

translations.literal: Those who responded numbered one hundred seventy thousand in all; thereby Suo's reputation shook Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Those who responded numbered one hundred seventy thousand in all; thereby Suo's reputation shook Hebei.

sentences.zh: 故綱以為招撫河北，非所不可。

translations.literal: Therefore Gang held that to pacify Hebei, none but Suo would do.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Gang held that to pacify Hebei, none but Suo would do.

sentences.zh: 傅亮者，先以邊功得官，嘗治兵河朔。

translations.literal: Fu Liang had first obtained office through frontier achievement and had once organized troops in Heshuo.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Liang had first obtained office through frontier achievement and had once organized troops in Heshuo.

sentences.zh: 都城受圍時，亮率勤王之兵三萬人，屢立戰功。

translations.literal: When the capital was besieged, Liang led thirty thousand troops coming to rescue the throne and repeatedly achieved military merit.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital was besieged, Liang led thirty thousand troops coming to rescue the throne and repeatedly achieved military merit.

sentences.zh: 綱察其智略可以大用，欲因此試之。

translations.literal: Gang observed that his wisdom and strategy could be greatly employed and wished thereby to test him.
translations.idiomatic: Gang observed that his wisdom and strategy could be greatly employed and wished thereby to test him.

sentences.zh: 上乃以所為河北招撫使，亮為河東經制副使。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon made Suo Pacification Commissioner of Hebei and Liang Deputy Control Commissioner of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thereupon made Suo Pacification Commissioner of Hebei and Liang Deputy Control Commissioner of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 皇子生，故事當肆赦。

translations.literal: When a prince was born, by precedent there ought to be a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: When a prince was born, by precedent there ought to be a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 綱奏：「陛下登極，曠蕩之恩獨遺河北、河東，而不及勤王之師，天下觖望。

translations.literal: Gang memorialized: "When Your Majesty ascended the throne, the sweeping grace alone omitted Hebei and Hedong and did not extend to the armies coming to rescue the throne—the realm was disappointed.
translations.idiomatic: Gang memorialized, "When Your Majesty ascended the throne, the sweeping grace alone omitted Hebei and Hedong and did not extend to the armies coming to rescue the throne—the realm was disappointed."

sentences.zh: 夫兩路為朝廷堅守，而赦令不及，人皆謂已棄之，何以慰忠臣義士之心？

translations.literal: The two circuits hold fast for the court yet the amnesty does not reach them—everyone says they have already been abandoned; how can the hearts of loyal ministers and righteous men be comforted?
translations.idiomatic: The two circuits hold fast for the court yet the amnesty does not reach them—everyone says they have already been abandoned; how can the hearts of loyal ministers and righteous men be comforted?

sentences.zh: 勤王之師在道路半年，擐甲荷戈，冒犯霜露，雖未效用，亦已勞矣。

translations.literal: The armies coming to rescue the throne have been on the road half a year, armored and bearing spears, braving frost and dew; though they have not yet been effective, they have already labored.
translations.idiomatic: The armies coming to rescue the throne have been on the road half a year, armored and bearing spears, braving frost and dew; though they have not yet been effective, they have already labored.

sentences.zh: 加以疾病死亡，恩恤不及，後有急難，何以使人乎？

translations.literal: Add to this illness and death with no gracious relief—when there is urgent peril hereafter, how can people be employed?
translations.idiomatic: Add to this illness and death with no gracious relief—when there is urgent peril hereafter, how can people be employed?

sentences.zh: 願因今赦廣示德意。

translations.literal: I wish that by this amnesty virtue be broadly displayed."
translations.idiomatic: I wish that by this amnesty virtue be broadly displayed."

sentences.zh: 」上嘉納。

translations.literal: The emperor approved and accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved and accepted.

sentences.zh: 於是兩路知天子德意，人情翕然，間有以破敵捷書至者。

translations.literal: Thereupon the two circuits knew the Son of Heaven's gracious intent; popular sentiment was harmonious; occasionally there arrived reports of defeating the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the two circuits knew the Son of Heaven's gracious intent; popular sentiment was harmonious; occasionally there arrived reports of defeating the enemy.

sentences.zh: 金人圍守諸郡之兵，往往引去。

translations.literal: The Jurchen troops besieging and holding the various commanderies often withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchen troops besieging and holding the various commanderies often withdrew.

sentences.zh: 而山砦之兵，應招撫、經制二司募者甚眾。

translations.literal: Meanwhile the mountain-fortress troops responding to recruitment by the Pacification and Control offices were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile the mountain-fortress troops responding to recruitment by the Pacification and Control offices were very numerous.

sentences.zh: 有許高、許亢者，以防河而遁，謫嶺南，至南康謀變，守倅戮之。

translations.literal: There were Xu Gao and Xu Kang, who were charged with defending the river but fled, were demoted to Lingnan, and at Nankang plotted rebellion—the prefect and vice-prefect executed them.
translations.idiomatic: There were Xu Gao and Xu Kang, who were charged with defending the river but fled, were demoted to Lingnan, and at Nankang plotted rebellion—the prefect and vice-prefect executed them.

sentences.zh: 或議其擅殺，綱曰：「高、亢受任防河，寇未至而遁，沒途劫掠，甚于盜賊。

translations.literal: Some debated their unauthorized killing; Gang said: "Gao and Kang received commission to defend the river; before the bandits arrived they fled and along the way plundered—worse than bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Some debated their unauthorized killing; Gang said, "Gao and Kang received commission to defend the river; before the bandits arrived they fled and along the way plundered—worse than bandits.

sentences.zh: 朝廷不能正軍法，而一守倅能行之，真健吏也。

translations.literal: The court could not rectify military law, yet one vice-prefect could carry it out—a truly vigorous official.
translations.idiomatic: The court could not rectify military law, yet one vice-prefect could carry it out—a truly vigorous official.

sentences.zh: 使受命捍賊而欲退走者，知郡縣之吏皆得以誅之，其亦少知所戒乎！

translations.literal: Let those who receive commission to resist bandits yet wish to retreat know that prefectural and county officials can all execute them—they will somewhat know to take warning!"
translations.idiomatic: Let those who receive commission to resist bandits yet wish to retreat know that prefectural and county officials can all execute them—they will somewhat know to take warning!"

sentences.zh: 」上以為然，命轉一官。

translations.literal: The emperor held this correct and ordered one rank of promotion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held this correct and ordered one rank of promotion.

sentences.zh: 開封守闕，綱以留守非宗澤不可，力薦之。

translations.literal: The Kaifeng commission was vacant; Gang held that for commissioner none but Zong Ze would do and strongly recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: The Kaifeng commission was vacant; Gang held that for commissioner none but Zong Ze would do and strongly recommended him.

sentences.zh: 澤至，撫循軍民，修治樓櫓，屢出師以挫敵。

translations.literal: When Ze arrived, he reassured soldiers and civilians, repaired towers and parapets, and repeatedly led troops out to frustrate the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: When Ze arrived, he reassured soldiers and civilians, repaired towers and parapets, and repeatedly led troops out to frustrate the enemy.

sentences.zh: 綱立軍法，五人為伍，伍長以牌書同伍四人姓名。

translations.literal: Gang established military law: five men formed a squad; the squad leader wrote on a tally the names of the four others in the squad.
translations.idiomatic: Gang established military law: five men formed a squad; the squad leader wrote on a tally the names of the four others in the squad.

sentences.zh: 二十五人為甲，甲正以牌書伍長五人姓名。

translations.literal: Twenty-five men formed a company; the company chief wrote on a tally the names of the five squad leaders.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-five men formed a company; the company chief wrote on a tally the names of the five squad leaders.

sentences.zh: 百人為隊，隊將以牌書甲正四人姓名。

translations.literal: One hundred men formed a platoon; the platoon commander wrote on a tally the names of the four company chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: One hundred men formed a platoon; the platoon commander wrote on a tally the names of the four company chiefs.

sentences.zh: 五百人為部，部將以牌書隊將正副十人姓名。

translations.literal: Five hundred men formed a section; the section commander wrote on a tally the names of the ten platoon commanders, primary and secondary.
translations.idiomatic: Five hundred men formed a section; the section commander wrote on a tally the names of the ten platoon commanders, primary and secondary.

sentences.zh: 二千五百人為軍，統制官以牌書部將正副十人姓名。

translations.literal: Two thousand five hundred men formed an army; the commanding general wrote on a tally the names of the ten section commanders, primary and secondary.
translations.idiomatic: Two thousand five hundred men formed an army; the commanding general wrote on a tally the names of the ten section commanders, primary and secondary.

sentences.zh: 命招置新軍及禦營司兵，並依新法團結，有所呼召、使令，按牌以遣。

translations.literal: He ordered recruitment of new armies and Imperial Camp troops all to be organized by the new law; whenever there was summons or assignment, according to the tally they were dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered recruitment of new armies and Imperial Camp troops all to be organized by the new law; whenever there was summons or assignment, according to the tally they were dispatched.

sentences.zh: 三省、樞密院置賞功司，受賂乞取者行軍法，遇敵逃潰者斬，因而為盜賊者，誅及其家屬。

translations.literal: The Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs established an Office for Rewarding Merit; those who accepted bribes and solicited were punished by military law; those who fled before the enemy were beheaded; those who thereby became bandits—their families were executed.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments and Bureau of Military Affairs established an Office for Rewarding Merit; those who accepted bribes and solicited were punished by military law; those who fled before the enemy were beheaded; those who thereby became bandits—their families were executed.

sentences.zh: 凡軍政申明改更者數十條。

translations.literal: In all, several tens of articles clarifying and changing military government were memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: In all, several tens of articles clarifying and changing military government were memorialized.

sentences.zh: 又奏步不足以勝騎，騎不足以勝車，請以車制頒京東、西，製造而教閱之。

translations.literal: He also memorialized that infantry cannot overcome cavalry, cavalry cannot overcome chariots—he requested that the chariot system be promulgated in the eastern and western capital circuits, manufactured and drilled.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized that infantry cannot overcome cavalry, cavalry cannot overcome chariots—he requested that the chariot system be promulgated in the eastern and western capital circuits, manufactured and drilled.

sentences.zh: 又奏造戰艦，募水軍，及詢訪諸路武臣材略之可任者以備用。

translations.literal: He also memorialized building warships, recruiting naval forces, and inquiring throughout the circuits for military officers of talent and strategy who could be employed.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized building warships, recruiting naval forces, and inquiring throughout the circuits for military officers of talent and strategy who could be employed.

sentences.zh: 又進三疏：一曰募兵，二曰買馬，三曰募民出財以助兵費。

translations.literal: He also submitted three memorials: first, recruiting soldiers; second, purchasing horses; third, recruiting civilians to contribute wealth to assist military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: He also submitted three memorials: first, recruiting soldiers; second, purchasing horses; third, recruiting civilians to contribute wealth to assist military expenses.

sentences.zh: 諫議大夫宋齊愈聞而笑之，謂虞部員外郎張浚曰：「李丞相三議，無一可行者。

translations.literal: Remonstrance Officer Song Qiyu heard this and laughed, saying to Secretary of the Ministry of Works Zhang Jun: "Chief Minister Li's three proposals—not one can be carried out."
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance Officer Song Qiyu heard this and laughed, saying to Secretary of the Ministry of Works Zhang Jun, "Chief Minister Li's three proposals—not one can be carried out."

sentences.zh: 」浚問之，齊愈曰：「民財不可盡括；

translations.literal: Jun asked him; Qiyu said: "The people's wealth cannot be entirely scraped;
translations.idiomatic: Jun asked him; Qiyu said, "The people's wealth cannot be entirely scraped;

sentences.zh: 西北之馬不可得，而東南之馬不可用；

translations.literal: horses of the northwest cannot be obtained, and horses of the southeast cannot be used;
translations.idiomatic: horses of the northwest cannot be obtained, and horses of the southeast cannot be used;

sentences.zh: 至於兵數，若郡增二千，則歲用千萬緡，費將安出？

translations.literal: as for troop numbers, if each commandery adds two thousand, then annual expense is ten million strings—whence will the cost come?
translations.idiomatic: as for troop numbers, if each commandery adds two thousand, then annual expense is ten million strings—whence will the cost come?

sentences.zh: 齊愈將極論之。

translations.literal: Qiyu is about to argue to the utmost."
translations.idiomatic: Qiyu is about to argue to the utmost."

sentences.zh: 」浚曰：「公受禍自此始矣。」

translations.literal: Jun said: "Disaster will begin for you from this."
translations.idiomatic: Jun said, "Disaster will begin for you from this."

sentences.zh: 時朝廷議遣使于金，綱奏曰：「堯、舜之道，孝悌而已，孝悌之至，可以通神明。

translations.literal: At that time the court debated sending envoys to the Jurchens; Gang memorialized, saying: "The way of Yao and Shun is filial piety and brotherliness alone; the utmost of filial piety and brotherliness can penetrate to the spirits.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the court debated sending envoys to the Jurchens; Gang memorialized, saying, "The way of Yao and Shun is filial piety and brotherliness alone; the utmost of filial piety and brotherliness can penetrate to the spirits.

sentences.zh: 陛下以二聖遠狩沙漠，食不甘味，寢不安席，思迎還兩宮，致天下養，此孝悌之至，而堯、舜之用心也。

translations.literal: Your Majesty, with the Two Emperors far on campaign in the desert, finds food not sweet and sleep not restful, thinking to welcome back the two palaces and support the realm with all under Heaven—this is the utmost of filial piety and brotherliness and the mind of Yao and Shun.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty, with the Two Emperors far on campaign in the desert, finds food not sweet and sleep not restful, thinking to welcome back the two palaces and support the realm with all under Heaven—this is the utmost of filial piety and brotherliness and the mind of Yao and Shun.

sentences.zh: 今日之事，正當枕戈嘗膽，內修外攘，使刑政修而中國強，則二帝不俟迎請而自歸。

translations.literal: Today's affair ought rightly to be sleeping on weapons and tasting gall, cultivating within and repelling without, making punishments and government sound and China strong—then the two emperors need not await welcome and will return of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Today's affair ought rightly to be sleeping on weapons and tasting gall, cultivating within and repelling without, making punishments and government sound and China strong—then the two emperors need not await welcome and will return of themselves.

sentences.zh: 不然，雖冠蓋相望，卑辭厚禮，恐亦無益。

translations.literal: Otherwise, though envoys' caps and covers succeed one another and humble words and thick gifts are offered, I fear it will also be of no benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, though envoys' caps and covers succeed one another and humble words and thick gifts are offered, I fear it will also be of no benefit.

sentences.zh: 今所遣使，但當奉表通問兩宮，致思慕之意可也。

translations.literal: The envoys now sent ought only to submit tables conveying inquiry to the two palaces and expressing the intent of longing—that is sufficient."
translations.idiomatic: The envoys now sent ought only to submit tables conveying inquiry to the two palaces and expressing the intent of longing—that is sufficient."

sentences.zh: 」上乃命綱草表，以周望、傅雱為二聖通問使，奉表以往。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon ordered Gang to draft the table and made Zhou Wang and Fu Biao envoys to inquire after the Two Emperors, submitting the table and proceeding.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thereupon ordered Gang to draft the table and made Zhou Wang and Fu Biao envoys to inquire after the Two Emperors, submitting the table and proceeding.

sentences.zh: 且乞降哀痛之詔，以感動天下，使同心協力，相與扶持，以致中興。

translations.literal: He also requested an edict of deep grief to move the realm, so that all would join hearts and strength, mutually supporting to achieve restoration.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested an edict of deep grief to move the realm, so that all would join hearts and strength, mutually supporting to achieve restoration.

sentences.zh: 又乞省冗員，節浮費。

translations.literal: He also requested reducing redundant posts and restraining extravagant expenses.
translations.idiomatic: He also requested reducing redundant posts and restraining extravagant expenses.

sentences.zh: 上皆從其言。

translations.literal: The emperor all followed his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor all followed his words.

sentences.zh: 是時，四方潰兵為盜者十余萬人，攻劫山東、淮南、襄漢之間，綱命將悉討平之。

translations.literal: At that time routed troops from the four quarters who became bandits numbered more than one hundred thousand, attacking and plundering between Shandong, Huainan, and Xianghan; Gang ordered generals to suppress and pacify them all.
translations.idiomatic: At that time routed troops from the four quarters who became bandits numbered more than one hundred thousand, attacking and plundering between Shandong, Huainan, and Xianghan; Gang ordered generals to suppress and pacify them all.

sentences.zh: 一日，論靖康時事，上曰：「淵聖勤於政事，省覽章奏，至終夜不寐，然卒致播遷，何耶？

translations.literal: One day, discussing Jingkang affairs, the emperor said: "The Hidden Sage was diligent in government affairs, reviewing memorials, until the end of the night without sleep—yet in the end he was driven to wander abroad; why?"
translations.idiomatic: One day, discussing Jingkang affairs, the emperor said, "The Hidden Sage was diligent in government affairs, reviewing memorials, until the end of the night without sleep—yet in the end he was driven to wander abroad; why?"

sentences.zh: 」綱曰：「人主之職在知人，進君子而退小人，則大功可成，否則衡石程書，無益也。

translations.literal: Gang said: "The ruler's task lies in knowing men—advance superior men and retire petty men, then great achievement can be accomplished; otherwise, weighing stones and scheduling documents is of no benefit."
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "The ruler's task lies in knowing men—advance superior men and retire petty men, then great achievement can be accomplished; otherwise, weighing stones and scheduling documents is of no benefit."

sentences.zh: 」因論靖康初朝廷應敵得失之策，且極論金人兩至都城，所以能守不能守之故；

translations.literal: He therefore discussed the gains and losses of the court's policies for meeting the enemy at the beginning of Jingkang, and strongly discussed the reasons the Jurchens twice reached the capital could hold yet could not hold;
translations.idiomatic: He therefore discussed the gains and losses of the court's policies for meeting the enemy at the beginning of Jingkang, and strongly discussed the reasons the Jurchens twice reached the capital could hold yet could not hold;

sentences.zh: 因勉上以明恕盡人言，以恭儉足國用，以英果斷大事。

translations.literal: he thereby urged the emperor to be intelligent and forgiving, exhaust all men's words, use respect and frugality to fill the state's needs, and use resolute decisiveness for great affairs.
translations.idiomatic: he thereby urged the emperor to be intelligent and forgiving, exhaust all men's words, use respect and frugality to fill the state's needs, and use resolute decisiveness for great affairs.

sentences.zh: 上皆嘉納。

translations.literal: The emperor all approved and accepted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor all approved and accepted.

sentences.zh: 又奏：「臣嘗言車駕巡幸之所，關中為上，襄陽次之，建康為下。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "Your servant once said that for the imperial carriage's tour, Guanzhong is first, Xiangyang second, Jiankang last.
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized, "Your servant once said that for the imperial carriage's tour, Guanzhong is first, Xiangyang second, Jiankang last.

sentences.zh: 陛下縱未能行上策，猶當且適襄、鄧，示不忘故都，以系天下之心。

translations.literal: Your Majesty, though unable for the moment to carry out the highest strategy, ought at least to go to Xiang and Deng, showing that you do not forget the old capital, to bind the hearts of the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty, though unable for the moment to carry out the highest strategy, ought at least to go to Xiang and Deng, showing that you do not forget the old capital, to bind the hearts of the realm.

sentences.zh: 不然，中原非復我有，車駕還闕無期，天下之勢遂傾不復振矣。

translations.literal: Otherwise the Central Plain will no longer be ours; the imperial carriage's return to the capital will have no date—the realm's situation will then tilt and never again be revived."
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise the Central Plain will no longer be ours; the imperial carriage's return to the capital will have no date—the realm's situation will then tilt and never again be revived."

sentences.zh: 」上為詔諭兩京以還都之意，讀者皆感泣。

translations.literal: The emperor issued an edict proclaiming to the two capitals the intent of returning to the capital; readers all wept.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued an edict proclaiming to the two capitals the intent of returning to the capital; readers all wept.

sentences.zh: 未幾，有詔欲幸東南避敵，綱極論其不可，言：「自古中興之主，起於西北，則足以據中原而有東南，起于東南，則不能以復中原而有西北。

translations.literal: Before long there was an edict wishing to travel southeast to avoid the enemy; Gang strongly argued it was impossible, saying: "Since ancient times lords who restored [dynasties], rising in the northwest, could thereby hold the Central Plain and possess the southeast; rising in the southeast, they could not thereby recover the Central Plain and possess the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Before long there was an edict wishing to travel southeast to avoid the enemy; Gang strongly argued it was impossible, saying, "Since ancient times lords who restored dynasties, rising in the northwest, could thereby hold the Central Plain and possess the southeast; rising in the southeast, they could not thereby recover the Central Plain and possess the northwest.

sentences.zh: 蓋天下精兵健馬皆在西北，一旦委中原而棄之，豈惟金人將乘間以擾內地；

translations.literal: For the realm's elite troops and strong horses are all in the northwest; once the Central Plain is cast aside and abandoned, not only will the Jurchens seize the opportunity to harass the interior;
translations.idiomatic: For the realm's elite troops and strong horses are all in the northwest; once the Central Plain is cast aside and abandoned, not only will the Jurchens seize the opportunity to harass the interior;

sentences.zh: 盜賊亦將蜂起為亂，跨州連邑，陛下雖欲還闕，不可得矣，況欲治兵勝敵以歸二聖哉？

translations.literal: bandits will also rise like bees in disorder, spanning prefectures and linking districts—even if Your Majesty wishes to return to the capital, it cannot be obtained, how much less govern troops and defeat the enemy to restore the Two Emperors!
translations.idiomatic: bandits will also rise like bees in disorder, spanning prefectures and linking districts—even if Your Majesty wishes to return to the capital, it cannot be obtained, how much less govern troops and defeat the enemy to restore the Two Emperors!

sentences.zh: 夫南陽光武之所興，有高山峻嶺可以控扼，有寬城平野可以屯兵；

translations.literal: Nanyang is where Emperor Guangwu of Han rose; there are high mountains and steep ridges for control and choke points, and broad cities and level fields for encamping troops;
translations.idiomatic: Nanyang is where Emperor Guangwu of Han rose; there are high mountains and steep ridges for control and choke points, and broad cities and level fields for encamping troops;

sentences.zh: 西鄰關、陝，可以召將士；

translations.literal: to the west it adjoins Guan and Shaan, where generals and soldiers can be summoned;
translations.idiomatic: to the west it adjoins Guan and Shaan, where generals and soldiers can be summoned;

sentences.zh: 東達江、淮，可以運穀粟；

translations.literal: to the east it reaches the Jiang and Huai, where grain can be transported;
translations.idiomatic: to the east it reaches the Jiang and Huai, where grain can be transported;

sentences.zh: 南通荊湖、巴蜀，可以取財貨；

translations.literal: to the south it connects Jinghu and Bashu, where wealth and goods can be obtained;
translations.idiomatic: to the south it connects Jinghu and Bashu, where wealth and goods can be obtained;

sentences.zh: 北距三都，可以遣救援。

translations.literal: to the north it is distant from the three capitals, where rescue can be dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: to the north it is distant from the three capitals, where rescue can be dispatched.

sentences.zh: 暫議駐蹕，乃還汴都，策無出於此者。

translations.literal: Temporarily to deliberate halting the imperial progress, then return to Bian capital—no strategy surpasses this.
translations.idiomatic: Temporarily to deliberate halting the imperial progress, then return to Bian capital—no strategy surpasses this.

sentences.zh: 今乘舟順流而適東南，固甚安便，第恐一失中原，則東南不能必其無事，雖欲退保一隅，不易得也。

translations.literal: Now to take boats downstream and go to the southeast is indeed very safe and convenient—but I fear that once the Central Plain is lost, then the southeast cannot be guaranteed free of trouble; even if you wish to retreat and preserve one corner, it is not easily obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Now to take boats downstream and go to the southeast is indeed very safe and convenient—but I fear that once the Central Plain is lost, then the southeast cannot be guaranteed free of trouble; even if you wish to retreat and preserve one corner, it is not easily obtained.

sentences.zh: 況嘗降詔許留中原，人心悅服，奈何詔墨未幹，遽失大信於天下！

translations.literal: Moreover, an edict was once issued promising to remain in the Central Plain—the people's hearts were pleased and submitted; how can the edict's ink not yet be dry and great faith with the realm be suddenly lost!"
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, an edict was once issued promising to remain in the Central Plain—the people's hearts were pleased and submitted; how can the edict's ink not yet be dry and great faith with the realm be suddenly lost!"

sentences.zh: 」上乃許幸南陽，而黃潛善、汪伯彥實陰上巡幸東南之議。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon assented to traveling to Nanyang, yet Huang Qianshan and Wang Boyan in fact secretly submitted the plan to tour southeast.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thereupon assented to traveling to Nanyang, yet Huang Qianshan and Wang Boyan in fact secretly submitted the plan to tour southeast.

sentences.zh: 客或有謂綱曰：「外論洶洶，鹹謂東幸已決。

translations.literal: A guest once said to Gang: "Outside talk is turbulent—all say the eastern tour is decided."
translations.idiomatic: A guest once said to Gang, "Outside talk is turbulent—all say the eastern tour is decided."

sentences.zh: 」綱曰：「國之存亡，於是焉分，吾當以去就爭之。

translations.literal: Gang said: "The state's survival or destruction divides here—I shall contend with my going or staying."
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "The state's survival or destruction divides here—I shall contend with my going or staying."

sentences.zh: 」初，綱每有所論諫，其言雖切直，無不容納，至是，所言常留中不報。

translations.literal: At first, whenever Gang had something to discuss or remonstrate, though his words were cutting and direct, none failed to be accepted; from this time his words were often kept within and not answered.
translations.idiomatic: At first, whenever Gang had something to discuss or remonstrate, though his words were cutting and direct, none failed to be accepted; from this time his words were often kept within and not answered.

sentences.zh: 已而遷綱尚書左僕射兼門下侍郎，黃潛善除右僕射兼中書侍郎。

translations.literal: Before long Gang was transferred to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with concurrent appointment as Vice Director of the Chancellery; Huang Qianshan was made Right Vice Director with concurrent appointment as Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Gang was transferred to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with concurrent appointment as Vice Director of the Chancellery; Huang Qianshan was made Right Vice Director with concurrent appointment as Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 張所乞且置司北京，俟措置有緒，乃渡河。

translations.literal: Zhang Suo requested temporarily to establish the office at Northern Capital and only cross the river when arrangements were in order.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Suo requested temporarily to establish the office at Northern Capital and only cross the river when arrangements were in order.

sentences.zh: 北京留守張益謙，潛善黨也，奏招撫司之擾，又言自置司河北，盜賊益熾。

translations.literal: Northern Capital Commissioner Zhang Yiqian, a member of Qianshan's faction, memorialized that the Pacification Office was disruptive, and also said that since establishing the office in Hebei, bandits had grown fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Capital Commissioner Zhang Yiqian, a member of Qianshan's faction, memorialized that the Pacification Office was disruptive, and also said that since establishing the office in Hebei, bandits had grown fiercer.

sentences.zh: 綱言：「所尚留京師，益謙何以知其擾？

translations.literal: Gang said: "Suo is still kept in the capital—how does Yiqian know he is disruptive?
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "Suo is still kept in the capital—how does Yiqian know he is disruptive?

sentences.zh: 河北民無所歸，聚而為盜，豈由置司乃有盜賊乎？」

translations.literal: The people of Hebei have nowhere to return; gathering together they become bandits—how is it that bandits exist because the office was established?"
translations.idiomatic: The people of Hebei have nowhere to return; gathering together they become bandits—how is it that bandits exist because the office was established?"

sentences.zh: 有旨令留守宗澤節制傅亮，即日渡河。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Commissioner Zong Ze to control Fu Liang and cross the river that same day.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Commissioner Zong Ze to control Fu Liang and cross the river that same day.

sentences.zh: 亮言：「措置未就而渡河，恐誤國事。

translations.literal: Liang said: "Arrangements are not yet complete yet we cross the river—I fear ruining the affairs of state."
translations.idiomatic: Liang said, "Arrangements are not yet complete yet we cross the river—I fear ruining the affairs of state."

sentences.zh: 」綱言：「招撫、經制，臣所建明，而張所、傅亮，又臣所薦用。

translations.literal: Gang said: "The Pacification and Control offices were what your servant proposed, and Zhang Suo and Fu Liang were whom your servant recommended.
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "The Pacification and Control offices were what your servant proposed, and Zhang Suo and Fu Liang were whom your servant recommended.

sentences.zh: 今潛善、伯彥沮所及亮，所以沮臣。

translations.literal: Now Qianshan and Boyan obstruct Suo and Liang—it is to obstruct your servant.
translations.idiomatic: Now Qianshan and Boyan obstruct Suo and Liang—it is to obstruct your servant.

sentences.zh: 臣每覽靖康大臣不和之失，事未嘗不與潛善、伯彥議而後行，而二人設心如此，願陛下虛心觀之。

translations.literal: Your servant, whenever I read of the failure of great ministers' discord at Jingkang, never failed to discuss with Qianshan and Boyan before acting—yet the two set their hearts thus; I wish Your Majesty would observe with an open mind."
translations.idiomatic: Your servant, whenever I read of the failure of great ministers' discord at Jingkang, never failed to discuss with Qianshan and Boyan before acting—yet the two set their hearts thus; I wish Your Majesty would observe with an open mind."

sentences.zh: 」既而詔罷經制司，召亮赴行在。

translations.literal: Before long an edict abolished the Control Office and summoned Liang to the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: Before long an edict abolished the Control Office and summoned Liang to the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 綱言：「聖意必欲罷亮，乞以御筆付潛善施行，臣得乞身歸田。

translations.literal: Gang said: "If the sage intent certainly wishes to dismiss Liang, I request that the imperial brush be given to Qianshan to carry out, and your servant may beg to retire to the fields."
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "If the sage intent certainly wishes to dismiss Liang, I request that the imperial brush be given to Qianshan to carry out, and your servant may beg to retire to the fields."

sentences.zh: 」綱退，而亮竟罷，乃再疏求去。

translations.literal: Gang withdrew, and Liang was ultimately dismissed; he again submitted a memorial requesting to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Gang withdrew, and Liang was ultimately dismissed; he again submitted a memorial requesting to leave.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「卿所爭細事，胡乃爾？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The matters you contend over are petty—why thus?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "The matters you contend over are petty—why thus?"

sentences.zh: 」綱言：「方今人材以將帥為急，恐非小事。

translations.literal: Gang said: "At present talent in generals is urgent—I fear it is not a petty matter.
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "At present talent in generals is urgent—I fear it is not a petty matter.

sentences.zh: 臣昨議遷幸，與潛善、伯彥異，宜為所嫉。

translations.literal: Your servant yesterday deliberated relocating the court and differed from Qianshan and Boyan—I ought to be envied by them.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant yesterday deliberated relocating the court and differed from Qianshan and Boyan—I ought to be envied by them.

sentences.zh: 然臣東南人，豈不願陛下東下為安便哉？

translations.literal: Yet your servant is a man of the southeast—is it not that I do not wish Your Majesty to go east for safety and convenience?
translations.idiomatic: Yet your servant is a man of the southeast—is it not that I do not wish Your Majesty to go east for safety and convenience?

sentences.zh: 顧一去中原，後患有不可勝言者。

translations.literal: Only, once the Central Plain is abandoned, the afterward calamity is beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Only, once the Central Plain is abandoned, the afterward calamity is beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 願陛下以宗社為心，以生靈為意，以二聖未還為念，勿以臣去而改其議。

translations.literal: I wish Your Majesty to take the altars of state to heart, take the lives of the people to heart, take the Two Emperors' not yet returned to heart—do not because your servant leaves change this deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: I wish Your Majesty to take the altars of state to heart, take the lives of the people to heart, take the Two Emperors' not yet returned to heart—do not because your servant leaves change this deliberation.

sentences.zh: 臣雖去左右，不敢一日忘陛下。

translations.literal: Though your servant leaves Your Majesty's side, I dare not one day forget Your Majesty."
translations.idiomatic: Though your servant leaves Your Majesty's side, I dare not one day forget Your Majesty."

sentences.zh: 」泣辭而退。

translations.literal: Weeping, he bowed and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Weeping, he bowed and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 或曰：「公決于進退，於義得矣，如讒者何？

translations.literal: Someone said: "You are resolute in advance and retreat—in righteousness you have attained it; but what of slanderers?"
translations.idiomatic: Someone said, "You are resolute in advance and retreat—in righteousness you have attained it; but what of slanderers?"

sentences.zh: 」綱曰：「吾知盡事君之道，不可，則全進退之節，患禍非所恤也。

translations.literal: Gang said: "I know only to exhaust the way of serving one's lord; if it cannot be, then complete the integrity of advance and retreat—worry over calamity is not what is cherished."
translations.idiomatic: Gang said, "I know only to exhaust the way of serving one's lord; if it cannot be, then complete the integrity of advance and retreat—worry over calamity is not what is cherished."

sentences.zh: 初，二帝北行，金人議立異姓。

translations.literal: At first, when the two emperors traveled north, the Jurchens deliberated establishing a man of another surname.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when the two emperors traveled north, the Jurchens deliberated establishing a man of another surname.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書王時雍問于吳幵、莫儔，二人微言敵意在張邦昌，時雍未以為然。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Wang Shiyong asked Wu Qian and Mo Chou; the two subtly said the enemy's intent was in Zhang Bangchang—Shiyong did not yet consider it so.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Wang Shiyong asked Wu Qian and Mo Chou; the two subtly said the enemy's intent was in Zhang Bangchang—Shiyong did not yet consider it so.

sentences.zh: 適宋齊愈自敵所來，時雍又問之，齊愈取片紙書「張邦昌」三字，時雍意乃決，遂以邦昌姓名入議狀。

translations.literal: Just then Song Qiyu came from the enemy camp; Shiyong again asked him; Qiyu took a slip of paper and wrote the three characters "Zhang Bangchang"—Shiyong's intent was then decided, and he entered Bangchang's name in the deliberation document.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Song Qiyu came from the enemy camp; Shiyong again asked him; Qiyu took a slip of paper and wrote the three characters "Zhang Bangchang"—Shiyong's intent was then decided, and he entered Bangchang's name in the deliberation document.

sentences.zh: 至是，齊愈論綱三事之非，不報。

translations.literal: By this time Qiyu discussed the error of Gang's three proposals; there was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: By this time Qiyu discussed the error of Gang's three proposals; there was no reply.

sentences.zh: 擬章將再上，其鄉人嗛齊愈者，竊其草示綱。

translations.literal: He drafted a memorial about to submit again; a fellow townsman who resented Qiyu secretly stole the draft and showed it to Gang.
translations.idiomatic: He drafted a memorial about to submit again; a fellow townsman who resented Qiyu secretly stole the draft and showed it to Gang.

sentences.zh: 時方論僭逆附偽之罪，於是逮齊愈，齊愈不承，獄吏曰：「王尚書輩所坐不輕，然但遷嶺南，大諫第承，終不過逾嶺爾。

translations.literal: Just then they were deliberating the crimes of usurpation and adhering to the false; thereupon Qiyu was arrested; Qiyu did not confess; the prison officer said: "Minister Wang and the rest's offense is not light, yet they are only transferred to Lingnan—a great remonstrator like you, sir, if you confess, will in the end be no more than crossing the ridge."
translations.idiomatic: Just then they were deliberating the crimes of usurpation and adhering to the false; thereupon Qiyu was arrested; Qiyu did not confess; the prison officer said, "Minister Wang and the rest's offense is not light, yet they are only transferred to Lingnan—a great remonstrator like you, sir, if you confess, will in the end be no more than crossing the ridge."

sentences.zh: 」齊愈引伏，遂戮之東市。

translations.literal: Qiyu confessed; he was thereupon executed at the eastern market.
translations.idiomatic: Qiyu confessed; he was thereupon executed at the eastern market.

sentences.zh: 張浚為御史，劾綱以私意殺侍從，且論其買馬招軍之罪。

translations.literal: Zhang Jun, as censor, impeached Gang for killing an attendant from private intent and also discussed his crimes of purchasing horses and recruiting troops.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jun, as censor, impeached Gang for killing an attendant from private intent and also discussed his crimes of purchasing horses and recruiting troops.

sentences.zh: 詔罷綱為觀文殿大學士、提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: An edict dismissed Gang as Hanlin Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and Supervisor of the Dongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: An edict dismissed Gang as Hanlin Academician of the Hall for Viewing Culture and Supervisor of the Dongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 尚書右丞許翰言綱忠義，合之無以佐中興。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director Xu Han said Gang was loyal and righteous; to remove him was to have none to assist restoration.
translations.idiomatic: Right Vice Director Xu Han said Gang was loyal and righteous; to remove him was to have none to assist restoration.

sentences.zh: 會上召見陳東，東言：「潛善、伯彥不可任，綱不可去。

translations.literal: Just then the emperor summoned Chen Dong in audience; Dong said: "Qianshan and Boyan cannot be entrusted; Gang cannot be removed."
translations.idiomatic: Just then the emperor summoned Chen Dong in audience; Dong said, "Qianshan and Boyan cannot be entrusted; Gang cannot be removed."

sentences.zh: 」東坐誅。

translations.literal: Dong was sentenced to execution.
translations.idiomatic: Dong was sentenced to execution.

sentences.zh: 翰曰：「吾與東皆爭李綱者，東戮都市，吾在廟堂，可乎？

translations.literal: Han said: "Dong and I both contended for Li Gang—Dong was executed in the market, I am in the temple hall—is this permissible?"
translations.idiomatic: Han said, "Dong and I both contended for Li Gang—Dong was executed in the market, I am in the temple hall—is this permissible?"

sentences.zh: 」遂求去。

translations.literal: He thereupon requested to leave.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon requested to leave.

sentences.zh: 後有旨，綱落職居鄂州。

translations.literal: Afterward there was an edict that Gang be stripped of office and live at Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward there was an edict that Gang be stripped of office and live at Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 自綱罷，張所以罪去，傅亮以母病辭歸，招撫、經制二司皆廢。

translations.literal: From Gang's dismissal, Zhang Suo left because of crime, Fu Liang resigned because of his mother's illness, and the Pacification and Control offices were both abolished.
translations.idiomatic: From Gang's dismissal, Zhang Suo left because of crime, Fu Liang resigned because of his mother's illness, and the Pacification and Control offices were both abolished.

sentences.zh: 車駕遂東幸，兩河郡縣相繼淪陷，凡綱所規畫軍民之政，一切廢罷。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage then traveled east; the commanderies and districts of the two rivers fell in succession; all the military and civilian policies Gang had planned were entirely abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage then traveled east; the commanderies and districts of the two rivers fell in succession; all the military and civilian policies Gang had planned were entirely abolished.

sentences.zh: 金人攻京東、西，殘毀關輔，而中原盜賊蜂起矣。

translations.literal: The Jurchens attacked the eastern and western capitals, ravaged Guanfu, and bandits in the Central Plain rose like bees.
translations.idiomatic: The Jurchens attacked the eastern and western capitals, ravaged Guanfu, and bandits in the Central Plain rose like bees.
